	local function fn8(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local tbl5 = type(arg3) == "table" and arg3 or {}
		local obj = setmetatable({ Type = "Dialog", Idx = arg2, Elements = {}, Destroyed = false }, tbl4)
		local tbl6 = {}
		local v2 = pairs
		local footerButtons = tbl5.FooterButtons or {}

		for k, footerButton in v2(footerButtons) do
			if type(footerButton) == "table" then
				tbl6[#tbl6 + 1] = { Name = k, Spec = footerButton, Order = tonumber(footerButton.Order) or 99 }
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl6, function(arg4, arg5)
			return arg4.Order < arg5.Order
		end)

		local tbl7 = {}

		for _, v3 in ipairs(tbl6) do

			local str = tostring(spec.Variant or "Primary")

			elseif str == "Destructive" then
				str = "Primary"
			end

			tbl7[#tbl7 + 1] = {
				Title = tostring(spec.Title or v3.Name),
				Variant = str,
				Callback = function()
					obj.Destroyed = true

					if arg.Dialogs then
						arg.Dialogs[arg2] = nil
					end

					if type(spec.Callback) == "function" then
						local ok2, result2 = pcall(spec.Callback, obj)

						if not ok2 then
							warn("[Scarlet-SAE][Dialog] " .. tostring(result2))
						end
					end
				end,
			}
		end

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return arg.WindWindow:Dialog({
				Title = tostring(tbl5.Title or "Scarlet"),
				Content = tostring(tbl5.Description or ""),
				Width = tonumber(tbl5.Width) or 380,
				Buttons = tbl7,
			})
		end)

		obj.Wind = ok2 and result2 or nil
		local main = obj.Wind and obj.Wind.UIElements and obj.Wind.UIElements.Main or nil

		local Frame2 = Frame and new("Frame", {
			Name = "Container",

			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		}, Frame) or nil

		if Frame2 then

				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,

		end

		obj.Container = Frame2 or new("Frame", { Name = "Container", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false }, new("Frame", { Name = "ScarletDialogContent", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false }, tbl2.EnsureFloats()))
		obj.Holder = main

	local function fn9(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			local windWindow = arg.WindWindow
			local tab = windWindow.Tab
			local tbl5 = { Title = tostring(arg2) }
			local v2 = tostring
			local v3 = arg3
			local str

			if arg3 then
				str = v3
			else
				str = "circle"
			end

			tbl5.Icon = v2(str)
			return tab(windWindow, tbl5)
		end)

		if not ok2 or not result2 then
			local ok3

			ok3, result2 = pcall(function()
				return arg.WindWindow:Tab({ Title = tostring(arg2) })
			end)
		end

		if not result2 then
			warn("[Scarlet-SAE] Tab '" .. tostring(arg2) .. "' could not be created.")
		end

		local containerFrame = result2 and (result2.ContainerFrame or result2.UIElements and result2.UIElements.ContainerFrameCanvas) or nil

		local tbl5 = {
			Type = "Tab",
			Name = arg2,
			Icon = arg3,
			WindTab = result2,
			Canvas = containerFrame,
			Sides = {},
			Connections = {},
			Groupboxes = {},
			Elements = {},
			Destroyed = false,
			Index = #arg.Tabs + 1,
		}

		local function fn10()
			if not (containerFrame and containerFrame.Visible) then
				return
			end
			task.wait()
			task.wait()
			if not (containerFrame and containerFrame.Visible) then
				return
			end

			for _, groupboxe in ipairs(tbl5.Groupboxes) do
				local section = groupboxe.Section

				if section and section.Open and section.Opened ~= false then
					pcall(function()
						section:Open(true)
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		tbl5.Relayout = function()
			task.spawn(fn10)
		end

		local flag = false

		tbl5.QueueRelayout = function()
			if flag then
				return
			end
			flag = true

			task.delay(0.3, function()
				flag = false
				tbl5.Relayout()
			end)
		end

		if containerFrame then
			tbl5.Connections[#tbl5.Connections + 1] = containerFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(tbl5.Relayout)
		end

		tbl5.AddLeftGroupbox = function(arg4, arg5)
			local left = buildGroupbox(arg4, arg5, "Left")
			arg4.Groupboxes[#arg4.Groupboxes + 1] = left
			return left
		end

		tbl5.AddRightGroupbox = function(arg4, arg5)
			local right = buildGroupbox(arg4, arg5, "Right")
			arg4.Groupboxes[#arg4.Groupboxes + 1] = right
			return right
		end

		tbl5.AddGroupbox = function(arg4, arg5)
			arg5 = type(arg5) == "table" and arg5 or {}
			local v2 = buildGroupbox(arg4, arg5.Name or arg5.Title, arg5.Side or "Left")
			arg4.Groupboxes[#arg4.Groupboxes + 1] = v2
			return v2
		end

		tbl5.AddLeftTabbox = tbl5.AddLeftGroupbox
		tbl5.AddRightTabbox = tbl5.AddRightGroupbox

		tbl5.Show = function(arg4)
			if arg4.WindTab and arg4.WindTab.Select then
				pcall(function()
					arg4.WindTab:Select()
				end)
			end

			arg4.Relayout()
			return true
		end

		tbl5.Destroy = function(arg4)
			arg4.Destroyed = true

			for _, connection in ipairs(arg4.Connections) do
				pcall(function()
					connection:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			if arg4.WindTab and arg4.WindTab.Destroy then
				pcall(function()
					arg4.WindTab:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end

		arg.Tabs[#arg.Tabs + 1] = tbl5
		return tbl5
	end

	library.GetBetterColor = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if typeof(arg2) ~= "Color3" then
			return theme.Text
		end
		local color, v2, v3 = Color3.toHSV(arg2)
		return Color3.fromHSV(color, v2, math.clamp(v3 + (tonumber(arg3) or 0) / 100, 0, 1))
	end

	end

	library.Notify = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local n = tonumber(arg3) or 4
		local str = "Scarlet"
		local description = arg2

		if type(arg2) == "table" then
			description = arg2.Description or arg2.Text or arg2.Content or ""
			n = tonumber(arg2.Time or arg2.Duration) or n
			str = arg2.Title or str
		end

		local windUI = tbl2.WindUI

		if windUI then
			if pcall(function()
				windUI:Notify({ Title = tostring(str), Content = tostring(description), Duration = n, Icon = "flame" })
			end) then
				return true
			end
		end

		warn("[Scarlet] " .. tostring(description))
		return false
	end

	library.SetDPIScale = function(arg, arg2)

	library.Unload = function(arg)
		if arg.Unloaded then
			return
		end
		arg.Unloaded = true

		for _, signal in ipairs(signals) do
			pcall(function()
				signal:Disconnect()
			end)
		end

		table.clear(signals)

		if type(arg.OnUnload) == "function" then
			pcall(arg.OnUnload)
		end

		if arg.Window and arg.Window.WindWindow then
			pcall(function()
				arg.Window.WindWindow:Close()
			end)

			pcall(function()
				arg.Window.WindWindow:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		if tbl2.WindUI then
			pcall(function()
				tbl2.WindUI.Window = nil
			end)
		end

		tbl2.DestroyFloats()
		arg.Toggled = false
	end

	library.ResetAllElements = function(arg)
		local n = 0

		for _, v2 in ipairs({ arg.Toggles, arg.Options }) do
			for _, v3 in pairs(v2) do
				if type(v3) == "table" and v3.Destroyed ~= true and v3.Default ~= nil and type(v3.SetValue) == "function" then
					if pcall(function()
						v3:SetValue(v3.Default)
					end) then
						n += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return n
	end

	library.CreateWindow = function(arg, arg2)
		local tbl5 = type(arg2) == "table" and arg2 or {}
		local v2 = tbl2.LoadWindUI()

		if not v2 then
			error("WindUI could not be downloaded: " .. tostring(tbl2.WindUIError), 0)
		end

		if rawget(v2, "Window") ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				v2.Window:Close()
			end)

			pcall(function()
				v2.Window:Destroy()
			end)

			pcall(function()
				v2.Window = nil
			end)

			if rawget(v2, "Window") ~= nil then
				tbl2.WindUI = nil
				getgenv().__SCARLET_WindUI = nil
				v2 = tbl2.LoadWindUI()

				if not v2 then
					error("WindUI could not be re-downloaded for this reload.", 0)
				end
			end
		end

		tbl2.RegisterTheme(v2)
		local size = tbl5.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(680, 540)
		local window = { Type = "Window", Tabs = {}, Dialogs = {}, Title = tbl5.Title or "Scarlet" }

		local ok2, windWindow = pcall(function()
			local createWindow = v2.CreateWindow
			local v3 = v2

			local tbl6 = {
				Title = tostring(tbl5.Title or "Scarlet"),
				Icon = theme.LogoId,
				IconRadius = 12,
				Author = tostring(tbl5.Footer or ""),
				Folder = "Scarlet",
				Size = size,
			}

			tbl6.MinSize = Vector2.new(560, 380)
			tbl6.MaxSize = Vector2.new(920, 620)
			tbl6.Theme = "Scarlet"
			tbl6.Background = theme.BackgroundId
			tbl6.BackgroundImageTransparency = 0.55
			tbl6.Transparent = true
			tbl6.Resizable = true
			tbl6.SideBarWidth = 178
			tbl6.HideSearchBar = false
			tbl6.ScrollBarEnabled = true
			tbl6.NewElements = true
			tbl6.Radius = 16
			tbl6.ShadowTransparency = 0.45
			tbl6.ToggleKey = tbl5.ToggleKeybind or Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
			tbl6.Topbar = { Height = 48, ButtonsType = "Default" }
			local color = Color3.fromRGB

			tbl6.OpenButton = {
				Title = "Scarlet",
				Enabled = true,
				Draggable = true,
				OnlyMobile = false,
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0),
				StrokeThickness = 2,
				Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(214, 36, 36), color(86, 0, 0)),
			}

			return createWindow(v3, tbl6)
		end)

		if not ok2 or not windWindow then
			error("WindUI rejected the window config: " .. tostring(windWindow), 0)
		end

		window.Wind = v2
		window.WindWindow = windWindow
		window.MainFrame = windWindow.UIElements and windWindow.UIElements.Main and windWindow.UIElements.Main.Main or nil
		window.WindScreenGui = v2.ScreenGui

		pcall(function()
			windWindow:Tag({ Title = tostring(tbl5.Footer or "Scarlet"), Icon = "flame", Color = theme.Accent })
		end)

		pcall(function()
			windWindow:SetToggleKey(tbl5.ToggleKeybind or Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			windWindow:SetBackgroundImage(theme.BackgroundId)
		end)

		window.AddTab = function(arg3, arg4, arg5)
			return fn9(arg3, arg4, arg5)
		end

		window.AddDialog = function(arg3, arg4, arg5)
			return fn8(arg3, arg4, arg5)
		end

		window.AddGroupbox = function(arg3, arg4)
			local v3 = arg3.Tabs[1]
			return v3 and v3:AddGroupbox(arg4) or nil
		end

		window.Toggle = function(arg3, arg4)
			if arg4 == nil then
				arg4 = not library.Toggled
			end

			local toggled = arg4 == true
			library.Toggled = toggled

			pcall(function()
				if toggled then
					arg3.WindWindow:Open()
				else
					arg3.WindWindow:Close()
				end
			end)

			return toggled
		end

		window.SetOpenButtonEnabled = function(arg3, arg4)
			local isOpenButtonEnabled = arg4 == true

			pcall(function()
				arg3.WindWindow.IsOpenButtonEnabled = isOpenButtonEnabled
			end)

			pcall(function()
				arg3.WindWindow.OpenButtonMain:Visible(isOpenButtonEnabled)
			end)

			return isOpenButtonEnabled
		end

		window.SelectTab = function(arg3, arg4)
			local v3 = arg3.Tabs[tonumber(arg4) or 1]

			if v3 then
				v3:Show()
			end
		end

		window.Destroy = function()
			library:Unload()
		end

		library.Window = window
		library.ScreenGui = tbl2.EnsureFloats()

		if tbl5.AutoShow == false then
			window:Toggle(false)
			window:SetOpenButtonEnabled(false)
		else
			window:Toggle(true)
		end

		return window
	end

	local saveManager = { Library = nil, Folder = "Scarlet", SubFolder = "", Ignore = {} }
	tbl2.SaveManager = saveManager

	local function fn10()
		return type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" and type(listfiles) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and type(isfolder) == "function"
	end

	saveManager.SetLibrary = function(arg, library2)
		arg.Library = library2
		return arg
	end

	saveManager.IgnoreThemeSettings = function(arg)
		return arg
	end

	saveManager.SetIgnoreIndexes = function(arg, arg2)
		local v2 = ipairs
		arg2 = type(arg2) == "table" and arg2 or {}

		for _, v3 in v2(arg2) do
			arg.Ignore[tostring(v3)] = true
		end

		return arg
	end

	saveManager.SetFolder = function(arg, arg2)
		arg.Folder = tostring(arg2 or "Scarlet")
		arg:BuildFolderTree()
		return arg
	end

	saveManager.SetSubFolder = function(arg, arg2)
		arg.SubFolder = tostring(arg2 or "")
		arg:BuildFolderTree()
		return arg
	end

	saveManager.GetPath = function(arg)
		local folder = arg.Folder
		local str

		if arg.SubFolder ~= "" then
			str = folder .. "/" .. arg.SubFolder
		else
			str = folder
		end

		return str .. "/settings"
	end

	saveManager.BuildFolderTree = function(arg)
		if not fn10() then
			return false
		end
		local tbl5 = { arg.Folder }

		if arg.SubFolder ~= "" then
			tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = arg.Folder .. "/" .. arg.SubFolder
		end

		tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = arg:GetPath()

		for _, v2 in ipairs(tbl5) do
			pcall(function()
				if not isfolder(v2) then
					makefolder(v2)
				end
			end)
		end

		return true
	end

	saveManager.SaveJSON = function(arg)
		local library2 = arg.Library or library
		local tbl5 = { objects = {} }

		for k, toggle in pairs(library2.Toggles) do
			if not arg.Ignore[k] and toggle.Destroyed ~= true then
				tbl5.objects[#tbl5.objects + 1] = { type = "Toggle", idx = k, value = toggle.Value == true }
			end
		end

		for k, option in pairs(library2.Options) do
			if not arg.Ignore[k] and option.Destroyed ~= true then
				if option.Type == "Input" then
					tbl5.objects[#tbl5.objects + 1] = { type = "Input", idx = k, value = tostring(option.Value or "") }
				elseif option.Type == "Slider" then
					tbl5.objects[#tbl5.objects + 1] = { type = "Slider", idx = k, value = tonumber(option.Value) or 0 }
				elseif option.Type == "Dropdown" then
					tbl5.objects[#tbl5.objects + 1] = { type = "Dropdown", idx = k, value = option.Value, multi = option.Multi == true }
				end
			end
		end

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return HttpService2:JSONEncode(tbl5)
		end)

		if not ok2 then
			return "", false, "encode failed"
		end
		return result2, true
	end

	saveManager.LoadJSON = function(arg, arg2)
		local library2 = arg.Library or library

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return HttpService2:JSONDecode(arg2)
		end)

		if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" or type(result2.objects) ~= "table" then
			return false, "invalid config"
		end

		for _, object in ipairs(result2.objects) do
			if type(object) == "table" and type(object.idx) == "string" and not arg.Ignore[object.idx] then
				local v2 = library2.Toggles[object.idx] or library2.Options[object.idx]

				if type(v2) == "table" and type(v2.SetValue) == "function" then
					pcall(function()
						v2:SetValue(object.value)
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	saveManager.Save = function(arg, arg2)
		if type(arg2) ~= "string" or arg2 == "" then
			return false, "no config name"
		end

		if not fn10() then
			return false, "executor has no file system"
		end
		arg:BuildFolderTree()
		local v2, v3, v4 = arg:SaveJSON(arg2)
		if not v3 then
			return false, v4 or "serialize failed"
		end

		if not pcall(function()
			local str = "/" .. arg2 .. ".json"
			writefile(arg:GetPath() .. str, v2)
		end) then
			return false, "write failed"
		end

		return true
	end

	saveManager.Load = function(arg, arg2)
		if type(arg2) ~= "string" or arg2 == "" then
			return false, "no config name"
		end

		if not fn10() then
			return false, "executor has no file system"
		end
		local str = arg:GetPath() .. "/" .. arg2 .. ".json"
		if not isfile(str) then
			return false, "config does not exist"
		end

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return readfile(str)
		end)

		if not ok2 then
			return false, "read failed"
		end
		return arg:LoadJSON(result2)
	end

	saveManager.Delete = function(arg, arg2)
		if type(arg2) ~= "string" or arg2 == "" then
			return false, "no config name"
		end

		if not fn10() or type(delfile) ~= "function" then
			return false, "delete unsupported"
		end
		local str = arg:GetPath() .. "/" .. arg2 .. ".json"
		if not isfile(str) then
			return false, "config does not exist"
		end

		local ok2 = pcall(function()
			delfile(str)
		end)

		return ok2, ok2 and nil or "delete failed"
	end

	saveManager.RefreshConfigList = function(arg)
		local tbl5 = {}
		if not fn10() then
			return tbl5
		end
		arg:BuildFolderTree()

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return listfiles(arg:GetPath())
		end)

		if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
			return tbl5
		end

		for _, v2 in ipairs(result2) do
			if tostring(v2):sub(-5) == ".json" then
				local match = tostring(v2):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")

				if match and match ~= "autoload" then
					tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = match
				end
			end
		end

		return tbl5
	end

	saveManager.GetAutoloadConfig = function(arg)
		if not fn10() then
			return nil
		end
		local str = arg:GetPath() .. "/autoload.txt"
		if not isfile(str) then
			return nil
		end

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return readfile(str)
		end)

		if not ok2 then
			return nil
		end
		local match = tostring(result2):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		return match ~= "" and match or nil
	end

	saveManager.SaveAutoloadConfig = function(arg, arg2)
		if not fn10() then
			return false, "executor has no file system"
		end
		arg:BuildFolderTree()

		local ok2 = pcall(function()
			local v2 = tostring
			writefile(arg:GetPath() .. "/autoload.txt", v2(arg2))
		end)

		return ok2, ok2 and nil or "write failed"
	end

	saveManager.DeleteAutoLoadConfig = function(arg)
		if not fn10() or type(delfile) ~= "function" then
			return false, "delete unsupported"
		end
		local str = arg:GetPath() .. "/autoload.txt"
		if not isfile(str) then
			return false, "no autoload config"
		end

		local ok2 = pcall(function()
			delfile(str)
		end)

		return ok2, ok2 and nil or "delete failed"
	end

	saveManager.LoadAutoloadConfig = function(arg)
		local autoloadConfig = arg:GetAutoloadConfig()
		if not autoloadConfig then
			return false, "no autoload config"
		end

		local v2, v3 = arg:Load(autoloadConfig)
		;(arg.Library or library):Notify(v2 and "Autoloaded config:" .. autoloadConfig or "Autoload failed:" .. tostring(v3), v2 and 4 or 5)
		return v2, v3
	end

	pcall(function()
		tbl2.ErrorSignal = game:GetService("ScriptContext").Error:Connect(function(arg, arg2)
			local genv2 = getgenv()
			local scarletMarkTrail = genv2.__SCARLET_MarkTrail
			local scarletLastTrail = type(scarletMarkTrail) == "table" and #scarletMarkTrail > 0 and table.concat(scarletMarkTrail, " > ") or "none"
			warn("[Scarlet-SAE][error] " .. tostring(arg) .. " | at: " .. tostring(genv2.__SCARLET_Mark or "?") .. " | trail: " .. scarletLastTrail)
			if genv2.__SCARLET_LastError then
				return
			end
			genv2.__SCARLET_LastError = tostring(arg)
			genv2.__SCARLET_LastTrace = tostring(arg2)
			genv2.__SCARLET_LastMark = tostring(genv2.__SCARLET_Mark or "?")
			genv2.__SCARLET_LastTrail = scarletLastTrail
		end)
	end)

	tbl2.InstallDiagnostics = function(arg)
		if not (arg and arg.WindTab) then
			return
		end

		local ok2, diagnosticsSection = pcall(function()
			return arg.WindTab:Section({ Title = "Diagnostics", Box = true, Opened = false, TextSize = 16 })
		end)

		if not ok2 or not diagnosticsSection then
			return
		end
		tbl2.DiagnosticsSection = diagnosticsSection

		local value = select(2, pcall(function()
			return diagnosticsSection:Paragraph({ Title = "collecting...", Desc = "" })
		end))

		if type(value) ~= "table" then
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while library and not library.Unloaded do
				task.wait(2)
				local tbl5 = {}
				tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = "Stage: " .. tostring(getgenv().__SCARLET_Stage or "?")
				local window = library.Window

				if window then
					local tbl6 = {}

					for _, tab in ipairs(window.Tabs) do
						local v2 = ipairs
						local groupboxes = tab.Groupboxes or {}
						local n = 0

						for _, groupboxe in v2(groupboxes) do
							n += #(groupboxe.Elements or {})
						end

						tbl6[#tbl6 + 1] = ("%s %d/%d"):format(tostring(tab.Name), #(tab.Groupboxes or {}), n)
					end

					tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = table.concat(tbl6, " | ")
				end

				tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = ("Failures: %d"):format(tbl2.Failures or 0)
				tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = "At: " .. tostring(getgenv().__SCARLET_Mark or "?")

				if getgenv().__SCARLET_LastMark then
					tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = "Error at: " .. tostring(getgenv().__SCARLET_LastMark) .. "  (" .. tostring(getgenv().__SCARLET_LastTrail or "") .. ")"
				end

				local scarletLastError = getgenv().__SCARLET_LastError

				if scarletLastError then
					tbl5[#tbl5 + 1] = "Error: " .. tostring(scarletLastError):sub(1, 220)
				end

				pcall(function()
					value:SetTitle(table.concat(tbl5, "\n"))
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	tbl2.BuildLibrary = function()
		return library
	end

	v = nil

local createFrame

createFrame = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	local control = tbl2.Theme.Control
	local controlHover = tbl2.Theme.ControlHover

	local outline = tbl2.Theme.Outline

	uiListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	uiListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

	for i, v2 in ipairs(arg3) do

		uiStroke.Thickness = 1

		end)

		textButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()

		end)

		textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(v2[2])
		textButton.Parent = frame
	end

	arg:AddUIPassthrough(arg2, { Instance = frame, Height = n })
	return frame
end

local tbl3

tbl3 = {
	DeferTabBuild = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if arg.__DeferredBuild then
			return arg.__DeferredBuild
		end
		local deferredBuild = { phase = "waiting", attempts = 0 }
		arg.__DeferredBuild = deferredBuild
		local canvas = arg.Canvas
		local tbl4 = {}

		local function fn6()
			for _, v2 in ipairs(tbl4) do
				v2:Disconnect()
			end

			table.clear(tbl4)
		end

		local function fn7()
			local flag = fn() and not arg.Destroyed
			local flag2

			if flag then
				flag2 = not canvas or canvas.Parent ~= nil
			else
				flag2 = flag
			end

			return flag2
		end

		local function fn8()
			return not canvas or canvas.Visible
		end

		local function fn9()
			if deferredBuild.phase ~= "waiting" and deferredBuild.phase ~= "failed" then
				return
			end

			if not fn7() then
				deferredBuild.phase = "cancelled"
				fn6()
				return
			end

			if not fn8() then
				return
			end
			deferredBuild.phase = "queued"

			task.defer(function()
				if not fn7() then
					deferredBuild.phase = "cancelled"
					fn6()
					return
				end

				if not fn8() then
					deferredBuild.phase = "waiting"
					return
				end
				deferredBuild.phase = "building"
				deferredBuild.attempts = deferredBuild.attempts + 1
				local flag = type(getthreadidentity) == "function" and type(setthreadidentity) == "function"
				local result = nil

				if flag then
					local ok
					ok, result = pcall(getthreadidentity)
					ok = ok and type(result) == "number"
					local v2 = nil

					if ok then
						pcall(setthreadidentity, 8)
					else
						result = v2
					end
				end

				local ok, result2 = pcall(arg2, fn7)

				if not fn7() then
					result2 = "session ended during construction"
					ok = false
				end

				if ok then
					deferredBuild.phase = "ready"
					fn6()
				else
					if arg3 then
						pcall(arg3)
					end

					deferredBuild.phase = fn7() and "failed" or "cancelled"

					if deferredBuild.phase == "cancelled" then
						fn6()
					else
						warn("[Scarlet] Deferred " .. tostring(arg.Name) .. " UI: " .. tostring(result2))

						pcall(function()
							v:Notify("Could not build " .. tostring(arg.Name) .. ". Reopen the tab to retry.", 5)
						end)
					end
				end

				if result ~= nil then
					pcall(setthreadidentity, result)
				end
			end)
		end

		if canvas then
			tbl4[#tbl4 + 1] = canvas:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(fn9)

			tbl4[#tbl4 + 1] = canvas.Destroying:Connect(function()
				deferredBuild.phase = "cancelled"
				fn6()
			end)

			for _, v2 in ipairs(tbl4) do
				arg.Connections[#arg.Connections + 1] = v2
				local scarletRuntimeConns = getgenv().__SCARLET_RuntimeConns

				if type(scarletRuntimeConns) == "table" then
					scarletRuntimeConns[#scarletRuntimeConns + 1] = v2
				end
			end
		end

		fn9()
		return deferredBuild
	end,

		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

	end,

local fn6

fn6 = function(arg)
	local n = tonumber(arg) or 0
	local flag = n < 0
	local n2 = math.abs(n)

	for _, v2 in ipairs({ { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } }) do
		if v2[1] <= n2 then
			local n3 = math.floor(n2 / v2[1] * 10) / 10
			local str = n3 % 1 == 0 and tostring(math.floor(n3)) or string.format("%.1f", n3)
			flag = flag and "-" or ""
			return flag .. str .. v2[2]
		end
	end

	return (flag and "-" or "") .. tostring(math.floor(n2))
end

local fn7

fn7 = function(arg)
	local n = math.floor(arg)
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", math.floor(n / 3600), math.floor(n % 3600 / 60), n % 60)
end

local fn8

fn8 = function(arg)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(arg.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(arg.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(arg.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

local fn9

fn9 = function(arg, arg2)
	task.wait(arg + math.random() * ((arg2 or arg) - arg))
end

local fn10

fn10 = function()
	local tbl4 = {}

	pcall(function()
		local tbl5 = {}

		for _, rarity in pairs(require(ReplicatedStorage.Data.Rarity).Rarities) do
			if type(rarity) == "table" and rarity._id and not tbl5[rarity._id] then
				tbl5[rarity._id] = true

				tbl4[#tbl4 + 1] = {
					id = rarity._id,
					num = tonumber(rarity.RarityNumber) or 0,
					color = rarity.Color,
					odds = rarity.DefaultRarityValue,
				}
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl4, function(arg, arg2)
			if arg.num ~= arg2.num then
				return arg.num > arg2.num
			end
			return arg.id < arg2.id
		end)
	end)

	return tbl4
end

	local function fn15(arg)
		local genv2 = getgenv()
		local value = rawget(genv2, "Clipboard")
		local value2 = rawget(genv2, "setclipboard") or rawget(genv2, "toclipboard")
		local set

		if value2 then
			set = value2
		else
			set = type(value) == "table" and value.set
		end

		if type(set) == "function" then
			pcall(set, arg)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

if type(v.AddDraggableButton) == "function" then
	v2.__VisibilityButton = v:AddDraggableButton("Scarlet", function()
	end, true, false)

	local visibilityButton = v2.__VisibilityButton
	local button = visibilityButton and visibilityButton.Button

	if button then
		local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		local absolutePosition = nil
		local v3 = nil
		local n = v.IsMobile and 14 or 8
		local n2 = 0
		local n3 = math.max(0.08, (v.WindowAnimationInfo and v.WindowAnimationInfo.Time or 0.2) + 0.04)
		local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		uiScale.Name = "ScarletPressScale"
		uiScale.Scale = 1
		uiScale.Parent = button
		local tween = nil
		local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.075, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local tweenInfo2 = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		button.Name = "ScarletVisibilityButton"
		button.Active = true
		button.Selectable = true
		button.Interactable = true
		button.AutoButtonColor = false
		button.RichText = true
		button.TextSize = 15
		button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 32)
		button.ZIndex = 100
		button:SetAttribute("ScarletInputMode", "Activated")
		button:SetAttribute("ScarletDragTolerance", n)
		button:SetAttribute("ScarletPressScale", 0.965)

		local function fn11(arg, arg2)
			if not uiScale.Parent then
				return
			end

			if tween then
				pcall(function()
					tween:Cancel()
				end)
			end

			tween = TweenService:Create(uiScale, arg2, { Scale = arg })
			tween:Play()
		end

		local function fn12()
			local flag = v.Toggled == true

			if v2.MainFrame then
				flag = v2.MainFrame.Visible
			end

			button:SetAttribute("ScarletWindowOpen", flag)
			button.Text = flag and "<b><font color=\"#8B0000\">Scarlet</font></b>" or "<b><font color=\"#C4C9D1\">Scarlet</font></b>"
		end

		local fn13 = nil

		fn13 = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
			if arg ~= n2 or not fn() or not button.Parent then
				return
			end
			v2:Toggle(arg2)
			fn12()
			if v.Toggled == arg2 then
				button:SetAttribute("ScarletToggleQueued", false)
				return
			end

			if arg3 < 4 then
				button:SetAttribute("ScarletToggleQueued", true)

				task.delay(n3, function()
					fn13(arg, arg2, arg3 + 1)
				end)
			else
				button:SetAttribute("ScarletToggleQueued", false)
			end
		end

		local function fn14()
			n2 += 1
			fn13(n2, v.Toggled ~= true, 1)
		end

		v:GiveSignal(button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			local userInputType = input.UserInputType

			if userInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or userInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				absolutePosition = button.AbsolutePosition
				v3 = input
				fn11(0.965, tweenInfo)
			end
		end))

		v:GiveSignal(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input ~= v3 then
				return
			end
			v3 = nil
			fn11(1, tweenInfo2)
		end))

		v:GiveSignal(button.Activated:Connect(function()
			local v4 = absolutePosition
			absolutePosition = nil
			if v4 and (button.AbsolutePosition - v4).Magnitude > n then
				return
			end
			fn14()
		end))

		if v2.MainFrame then
			v:GiveSignal(v2.MainFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(fn12))
		end

		fn12()
	end
end

	local function fn11()
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not currentCamera then
			return 1
		end
		local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
		local n2 = math.clamp(math.min(1, (viewportSize.X - n) / vector2.X, (viewportSize.Y - n) / vector2.Y), 0.55, 1)
		v:SetDPIScale(n2 * 100)
		local main = v.ScreenGui and v.ScreenGui:FindFirstChild("Main")

		if main and main:IsA("GuiObject") then
			main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(vector2.X * n2) / 2, 0.5, -(vector2.Y * n2) / 2)
		end

		return n2
	end

	fn11()

	v2.__ApplyMobileScrollFix = function(arg)
		local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		if not (v.IsMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled) then
			return
		end
		local v4 = ipairs
		local tbl7 = arg and { arg } or { home, eggs, progression, sell, event, v2.__WebhookTab, settings_ }

		for _, v5 in v4(tbl7) do
			local v6 = ipairs
			local sides = v5.Sides or {}

			for _, side in v6(sides) do

	tbl5.CreatePersistence = function(arg)
		local v4 = nil
		local flag = false
		local flag2 = false
		local tbl7 = { AutoSell = true, SellPetsWhenFull = true, AutoSellEggs = true, SellEggsWhenFull = true }

		local function fn16()
			if not v4 then
				return false
			end

			for k, setting in pairs(arg.settings) do
				if tbl7[k] then
					setting = false
				end

				local v5 = v4[k]

				if type(setting) == "table" then
					if type(v5) ~= "table" then
						return false
					end

					for k2, v6 in pairs(setting) do
						if v5[k2] ~= v6 then
							return false
						end
					end

					for k2, v6 in pairs(v5) do
						if setting[k2] ~= v6 then
							return false
						end
					end

					continue
				end

				if setting ~= v5 then
					return false
				end
			end

			for k in pairs(v4) do
				if not tbl7[k] and arg.settings[k] == nil then
					return false
				end
			end

			return true
		end

		return {
			Prime = function()
				if flag or not arg.alive() then
					return false
				end
				v4 = arg.snapshot()
				return true
			end,
			Save = function(arg2, arg3)
				if not arg.alive() or arg.blocked() then
					return false
				end

				if flag then
					if arg3 then
						flag2 = true
					end

					return false
				end

				if not arg3 and not flag2 and fn16() then
					return false
				end
				flag = true
				flag2 = false

				local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
					local v5 = arg.snapshot()
					local ok2, result2 = pcall(arg.encode, v5)
					if not ok2 then
						arg.meta.note = "encode failed"
						return false
					end

					if not arg.alive() or arg.blocked() then
						return false
					end

					if not pcall(arg.write, result2) then
						arg.meta.note = "write failed"
						return false
					end
					v4 = v5
					local meta = arg.meta
					arg.meta.lastSave = arg.time()
					meta.note = "saved"
					return true
				end)

				flag = false
				local flag3 = not ok2

				if flag3 then
					arg.meta.note = "save failed"
				end

				if flag3 or not result2 then
					flag2 = true
				end

				return ok2 and result2 == true
			end,
		}
	end

	tbl6.RiftPlanner.Plan = function(arg, arg2, arg3)

		local function fn16(arg4, arg5, arg6)
			local v5 = nil

			for _, v6 in ipairs(arg4) do

				if flag then
					flag = not v5 or v6.value < v5.value or v6.value == v5.value and v6.uid < v5.uid
				end

				if flag then
					v5 = v6
				end
			end

			return v5
		end

		for i, requirement in ipairs(arg.Requirements) do
			local v5 = fn16(arg2, requirement, tbl7.pets)
			local tbl8 = { category = requirement }

			if v5 then
				tbl7.pets[v5.uid] = true
				local waiting = v5.waiting == true
				tbl8.petUid = v5.uid

					tbl7.ready = false
				end
			else

	end

	local tbl7 = { [""] = 1, k = 1000, m = 1000000, b = 1e9, t = 1e12 }
	local tbl8 = { { 1e12, "T" }, { 1e9, "B" }, { 1000000, "M" }, { 1000, "K" } }

	local function fn16(arg)
		return type(arg) == "number" and arg == arg and arg >= 0 and arg < math.huge
	end

	tbl6.parseCompactValue = function(arg)
		if type(arg) == "number" then
			arg = fn16(arg) and arg or nil
			return arg
		end
		local str3 = tostring(arg or ""):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
		if str3 == "" then
			return 0
		end

		if str3:sub(1, 1) == "$" then
			str3 = str3:sub(2)
		end

		if str3 == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local match, v4 = str3:match("^([%d,]*%.?%d+)(%a*)$")
		local v5 = tbl7[v4]
		if not match or not v5 then
			return nil
		end
		local match2 = match:match("^([^%.]*)") or ""

		if match2 == "" then
			match2 = "0"
		end

		if match2:find(",", 1, true) then
			local match3, v6 = match2:match("^(%d%d?%d?)(,.*)$")
			if not match3 or not v6 or v6:gsub(",%d%d%d", "") ~= "" then
				return nil
			end
		elseif not match2:match("^%d+$") then
			return nil
		end

		local v6 = tonumber
		local str4 = match:gsub(",", "")
		local n2 = v6(str4)
		n2 = n2 and n2 * v5 or nil
		return fn16(n2) and n2 or nil
	end

	tbl6.formatCompactValue = function(arg)
		local n2 = tonumber(arg) or 0
		if not fn16(n2) or n2 == 0 then
			return "0"
		end
		local n3 = 1
		local str3 = ""

		for _, v4 in ipairs(tbl8) do
			if v4[1] <= n2 then
				n3 = v4[1]
				str3 = v4[2]
				break
			end
		end

		return ("%.6f"):format(n2 / n3):gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1"):gsub("%.$", "") .. str3
	end

	tbl6.formatThresholdConfirmation = function(arg)
		local n2 = tonumber(arg) or 0
		if not fn16(n2) or n2 == 0 then
			return "0"
		end
		local n3 = 1
		local str3 = ""
		local v4 = nil

		for i, v5 in ipairs(tbl8) do
			if v5[1] <= n2 then
				n3 = v5[1]
				str3 = v5[2]
				v4 = i
				break
			else
				v4 = nil
			end
		end

		local function fn17(arg2, arg3)
			local n4 = n2 / arg2
			local n5 = n4 >= 100 and 0
			local n6

			if n5 then
				n6 = n5
			else
				n6 = n4 >= 10 and 1

				if not n6 then
					n6 = n4 >= 1 and 2 or arg2 == 1 and 6 or 2
				end
			end

			return ("%%.%df"):format(n6):format(n4):gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1"):gsub("%.$", ""), arg3
		end

		local v5, v6 = fn17(n3, str3)

		if tonumber(v5) and tonumber(v5) >= 1000 and v4 and v4 > 1 then
			local v7 = tbl8[v4 - 1]
			v5, v6 = fn17(v7[1], v7[2])
		end

		return v5 .. v6
	end

	tbl6.setCommittedThresholdCaption = function(arg, arg2, arg3)

			end

			return true
		end

		v6:OnChanged(function(arg7)

			end
		end

		tbl6.valueFilterInputs[arg3] = {

				return textBox and textBox.Text or v6.Value
			end,
			Commit = function()

			end,
		}

		local scarletConfigControllers = getgenv().__SCARLET_ConfigControllers

		if type(scarletConfigControllers) == "table" then
			scarletConfigControllers[arg3] = {
				GetValue = function()
					return tbl4[arg3]
				end,
				SetValue = function(arg7, arg8)
					tbl6.markValueFilterChanged()
					local n2 = tbl6.parseCompactValue(arg8)

					if n2 == nil then
						local num = tonumber(tbl4[arg3])
						n2 = fn16(num) and num or 0
					end

					local v7 = tbl6.formatCompactValue(n2)
					local v8 = tbl6.parseCompactValue(v7)
					tbl4[arg3] = v8 ~= nil and v8 or 0
					fn18(tbl4[arg3])
					fn17()

					if arg5 then
						pcall(arg5, "config")
					end
				end,
			}
		end

		return v6
	end

	tbl6.finishStealTimer = function(arg, arg2)
		local stealTimer = tbl6.stealTimer
		local last = math.max(0, (tonumber(arg) or 0) + (tonumber(arg2) or 0))
		stealTimer.active = false
		stealTimer.last = last
		stealTimer.outTime = tonumber(arg) or 0
		stealTimer.backTime = tonumber(arg2) or 0
		stealTimer.completed = (tonumber(stealTimer.completed) or 0) + 1
		stealTimer.total = (tonumber(stealTimer.total) or 0) + last
		stealTimer.average = stealTimer.total / stealTimer.completed
		tbl6.set("stealTime", ("Time: %.2fs · %.2f out / %.2f back"):format(last, stealTimer.outTime, stealTimer.backTime))
		pcall(sessionMetrics.Set, sessionMetrics, "stealTime", ("%.2fs"):format(last))
		pcall(sessionMetrics.Set, sessionMetrics, "avgStealTime", ("%.2fs"):format(stealTimer.average))
	end

	tbl6.pauseStealTimer = function()

	end

	tbl6.failSameServerRejoin = function(arg, arg2)
		if not tbl6.sameServerRejoinPending then
			return
		end

		if arg2 ~= nil and tbl6.sameServerRejoinAttempt ~= arg2 then
			return
		end
		tbl6.sameServerRejoinPending = false
		tbl6.sameServerRejoinAttempt = nil
		tbl6.intentionalDisconnectUntil = 0
		tbl6.intentionalDisconnectReason = nil
		v:Notify("Same-server rejoin failed:" .. tostring(arg or "Teleport failed"), 5)
	end

	tbl6.requestSameServerRejoin = function(arg)
		if tbl6.sameServerRejoinPending or tbl6.serverHopPending then
			v:Notify("another teleport is already pending", 4)
			return false
		end
		local placeId = game.PlaceId
		local jobId = game.JobId
		if type(jobId) ~= "string" or jobId == "" then
			v:Notify("Same-server rejoin failed: job id unavailable", 5)
			return false
		end
		tbl6.sameServerRejoinPending = true
		local sameServerRejoinAttempt = {}
		tbl6.sameServerRejoinAttempt = sameServerRejoinAttempt
		tbl6.intentionalDisconnectUntil = os.clock() + 45
		tbl6.intentionalDisconnectReason = tostring(arg or "Same-server rejoin")

		task.spawn(function()
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, localPlayer)
			end)

			if not ok2 then
				tbl6.failSameServerRejoin(result2, sameServerRejoinAttempt)
			end
		end)

		task.delay(45, function()
			if fn() and tbl6.sameServerRejoinAttempt == sameServerRejoinAttempt then
				tbl6.failSameServerRejoin("teleport timed out", sameServerRejoinAttempt)
			end
		end)

		return true
	end

		getgenv().__SCARLET_RuntimeConns[#getgenv().__SCARLET_RuntimeConns + 1] = TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(arg, arg2, arg3)
			if arg ~= localPlayer then
				return
			end

			if os.clock() < (tonumber(tbl6.intentionalDisconnectUntil) or 0) then
				tbl6.failSameServerRejoin(arg3)
			end
		end)
	end)

	tbl6.retireStuckCarryRequest = function(arg)
		local scarletCarryRequest2 = getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest
		if type(scarletCarryRequest2) ~= "table" then
			return false
		end
		local now3 = tonumber(arg) or os.clock()
		if scarletCarryRequest2.session ~= tbl.Marker then
			getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest = nil
			return true
		end
		local n2 = tonumber(scarletCarryRequest2.started) or 0
		local n3 = now3 - n2

		if scarletCarryRequest2.inFlight ~= true then
			if scarletCarryRequest2.done == true and n2 > 0 and n3 > 60 then
				getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest = nil
				return true
			end
			return false
		end

		local flag = n2 <= 0

		if not flag then
			flag = n3 <= (tonumber(tbl6.carryInvokeDeadline) or 12)
		end

		if flag then
			return false
		end
		scarletCarryRequest2.timedOut = true
		scarletCarryRequest2.supersededByTimeout = true
		scarletCarryRequest2.inFlight = false
		scarletCarryRequest2.done = true
		scarletCarryRequest2.accepted = false
		scarletCarryRequest2.completedAt = now3
		scarletCarryRequest2.cooldownKind = "invoke-timeout"
		scarletCarryRequest2.error = string.format("carry invoke did not return within %ds", math.floor(n3))
		scarletCarryRequest2.retryAt = now3
		tbl17.lastRequestError = scarletCarryRequest2.error
		tbl17.lastRequestKind = "invoke-timeout"

		if getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest == scarletCarryRequest2 then
			getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest = nil
		end

		tbl6.carryInvokeTimeouts = (tbl6.carryInvokeTimeouts or 0) + 1
		warn("[Scarlet-SAE][steal] " .. scarletCarryRequest2.error .. " (uid " .. tostring(scarletCarryRequest2.uid) .. ") - lock released")

		if fn15 then
			pcall(fn15, "carry-invoke-timeout")
		end

		return true
	end

		end

local fn26

		v6 = tbl14 and tbl14.GetAreaEggSnapshot()

	if type(records) == "table" then
		return records
	end

	return candidateIndex and type(candidateIndex.records) == "table" and candidateIndex.records or {}
end

local fn27

fn27 = function(arg)
	for _, v6 in pairs(fn26()) do
		if tostring(v6.Uid or v6.UID or v6.EggUid) == tostring(arg) then
			return v6
		end
	end

	return nil
end

tbl6.carryLossAwaitingProof = function(arg)
	if arg == nil or tostring(tbl6.pendingDroppedUid) ~= tostring(arg) then
		return false
	end
	local scarletCarryRequest = getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest
	local flag = type(scarletCarryRequest) ~= "table" or tostring(scarletCarryRequest.uid) ~= tostring(arg) or scarletCarryRequest.carryEndedSeen == true

	if not flag then
		flag = (tonumber(scarletCarryRequest.started) or 0) <= (tonumber(tbl17.dropDetectedAt) or 0)
	end

	return flag
end

local fn28

fn28 = function()
	for _, v6 in pairs(fn26()) do
		local str = tostring(v6.State or "")
		local flag = str ~= "Dropped" and str ~= "GuardCarried" and str ~= "Claimed"

		if flag then
			local userId = localPlayer.UserId
			flag = tonumber(v6.CarrierUserId) == userId
		end

		flag = flag and not tbl6.carryLossAwaitingProof(v6.Uid)

		if flag then
			flag = not (tbl6.ChickenTP and tbl6.ChickenTP.isBait(v6.Uid))
		end

		if flag then
			return v6
		end
	end

	return nil
end

	if v6 ~= nil then
		local str = tostring(v6.State or "")
		local num = tonumber(v6.CarrierUserId)

		if str == "Dropped" or str == "GuardCarried" or str == "Claimed" then
			if str ~= "Claimed" and (tostring(tbl17.carriedUid) == tostring(lastDroppedUid) or flag and scarletCarryRequest.carrySeen == true) and tostring(tbl6.pendingDroppedUid) ~= tostring(lastDroppedUid) then
				tbl17.lastDroppedUid = lastDroppedUid
				tbl17.dropDetectedAt = os.clock()
				tbl17.lockedUid = lastDroppedUid
				tbl17.lastRequestKind = "carry-loss-sync"
				tbl17.lastRequestError = "guard carry loss; waiting to reclaim egg"
				tbl6.pendingDroppedUid = lastDroppedUid
			end

			if tostring(tbl17.carriedUid) == tostring(lastDroppedUid) then
				critical = false
			end

			if flag then
				scarletCarryRequest.carryActive = false

				if str == "Dropped" or str == "GuardCarried" then
					scarletCarryRequest.carryEndedSeen = true
					scarletCarryRequest.droppedSeen = true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		if num == localPlayer.UserId then
			if tbl6.carryLossAwaitingProof(lastDroppedUid) then
				return false
			end
			critical = true
			tbl17.carriedUid = lastDroppedUid
			tbl17.rememberPositiveCarry(lastDroppedUid)

			if flag then
				scarletCarryRequest.carrySeen = true
				scarletCarryRequest.carryActive = true
				scarletCarryRequest.carryEndedSeen = false
				scarletCarryRequest.droppedSeen = false
			end

			return true
		end

		if num ~= nil and num ~= localPlayer.UserId then
			if num > 0 and tostring(tbl17.carriedUid) == tostring(lastDroppedUid) then
				critical = false
			end

			if flag then
				scarletCarryRequest.carryActive = false
			end

			return false
		end
	end

	if critical and tbl17.carriedUid ~= nil and tostring(tbl17.carriedUid) == tostring(lastDroppedUid) and not tbl6.carryLossAwaitingProof(lastDroppedUid) then
		tbl17.rememberPositiveCarry(lastDroppedUid)

		if flag then
			scarletCarryRequest.carrySeen = true
			scarletCarryRequest.carryActive = true
			scarletCarryRequest.carryEndedSeen = false
			scarletCarryRequest.droppedSeen = false
		end

		return true
	end

	if flag then
		scarletCarryRequest.carryActive = false
	end

	return false
end

tbl18.wakeSeller = function()
	if not fn() then
		return
	end
	tbl18.sellerPending = true
	if tbl18.sellerWakeQueued then
		return
	end
	tbl18.sellerWakeQueued = true

	task.defer(function()
		tbl18.sellerWakeQueued = false

		if fn() then
			tbl18.sellWake:Fire()
		end
	end)
end

tbl18.waitSeller = function(arg)
	tbl18.cancelSellerTimer()

	if tbl18.sellerPending then
		tbl18.sellerPending = false
		task.wait(0.1)
		return
	end

	local sellerGeneration = tbl18.sellerGeneration

	tbl18.sellerTimer = task.delay(arg, function()
		if sellerGeneration ~= tbl18.sellerGeneration or not fn() then
			return
		end
		tbl18.sellerTimer = nil
		tbl18.wakeSeller()
	end)

	tbl18.sellWake.Event:Wait()
	tbl18.cancelSellerTimer()
	tbl18.sellerPending = false

tbl6.bossArenaOccupied = function()
	if localPlayer:GetAttribute("InBossArena") ~= true then
		return false
	end
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoidRootPart or not character or character.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local bossArena = workspace:FindFirstChild("BossArena")
	bossArena = bossArena and bossArena:FindFirstChild("Floor")
	if not bossArena or not bossArena:IsA("BasePart") then
		return true
	end
	local v6 = bossArena.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(humanoidRootPart.Position)
	local n2 = bossArena.Size.X * 0.5 + 32
	local flag = math.abs(v6.X) <= n2
	local flag2

	if flag then
		local n3 = bossArena.Size.Z * 0.5 + 32
		flag2 = math.abs(v6.Z) <= n3
	else
		flag2 = flag
	end

	local flag3

	if flag2 then
		local n3 = bossArena.Size.Y * 0.5 + 120
		flag3 = math.abs(v6.Y) <= n3
	else
		flag3 = flag2
	end

	return flag3
end

	return true
end

end

tbl18.acquire = function(yieldTo)
	if tbl6.blockArenaDeparture(yieldTo) then
		return false
	end
	local v6 = tbl18.protectedStealTransaction(yieldTo)

	if not tbl18.canTake(yieldTo) then
		if not v6 and tbl18.owner and tbl18.owner ~= yieldTo and tbl18.prioOf(yieldTo) > tbl18.prioOf(tbl18.owner) then
			tbl18.yieldTo = yieldTo
		end

		return false
	end

	local flag = tbl18.owner ~= yieldTo
	local v7 = tbl18
	local v8 = tbl18
	local v9 = tbl18
	local v10 = tbl18.prioOf(yieldTo)
	local now3 = os.clock()
	v7.owner = yieldTo
	v8.prio = v10
	v9.heartbeat = now3
	tbl18.yieldTo = nil

	if flag then
		tbl6.wakeOverlay("arbiter")
	end

	return true
end

tbl18.acquireWait = function(arg, arg2)

			return true
		end

		if os.clock() >= n2 then
			return false
		end

	end

	return false
end

	if tbl18.treadmillTraining and tbl18.petsBusy then

	if tbl18.petsBusy then

	tbl6.findMovementDispatcher = function(arg, arg2)

	fn43 = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6)

		else

	end

	tbl6.getMovementSpeed = function()

		if not tbl4.AutoCalibrateSpeed then

		end

		if not speedCalibration.current or speedCalibration.base ~= current or speedCalibration.current > 1000 then

			speedCalibration.successes = 0

	end

	tbl6.recordSpeedResult = function(arg, arg2)
		if not tbl4.AutoCalibrateSpeed then
			return
		end
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 - speedCalibration.lastResultAt < 0.5 then
			return
		end
		speedCalibration.lastResultAt = now3
		local lastReason = tostring(arg2 or arg and "verified" or "failed")
		local n4 = math.clamp(tonumber(tbl4.StealSpeed) or 800, 100, 1000)
		local stable = tonumber(speedCalibration.current) or n4
		local current = math.clamp(tonumber(speedCalibration.stable) or n4, n4, 1000)

		if arg then
			speedCalibration.failures = 0

			if speedCalibration.probeStep <= 0 then
				speedCalibration.successes = 0
				speedCalibration.current = current
				speedCalibration.lastReason = "environment hold"
			else
				speedCalibration.successes = speedCalibration.successes + 1
				speedCalibration.lastReason = lastReason

				if speedCalibration.successes >= speedCalibration.requiredSuccesses then
					speedCalibration.successes = 0
					speedCalibration.previousStable = current
					speedCalibration.stable = stable
					local current2 = math.min(1000, stable + speedCalibration.probeStep)
					speedCalibration.current = current2
					speedCalibration.lastReason = current2 > stable and "testing higher" or "maximum verified"
				end
			end
		else
			speedCalibration.successes = 0
			speedCalibration.failures = speedCalibration.failures + 1
			speedCalibration.lastReason = lastReason

			if stable > current then
				speedCalibration.current = current
				speedCalibration.lastReason = "rollback · " .. lastReason
			elseif speedCalibration.failures >= 2 and current > n4 then
				local stable2 = math.max(n4, tonumber(speedCalibration.previousStable) or current - 25)
				speedCalibration.stable = stable2
				speedCalibration.current = stable2
				speedCalibration.failures = 0
				speedCalibration.lastReason = "stability rollback"
			else
				speedCalibration.current = current
			end
		end

		local n5 = math.clamp(tonumber(speedCalibration.current) or n4, 100, 1000)

		if n5 ~= stable and type(tbl6.syncSpeedSlider) == "function" then
			pcall(tbl6.syncSpeedSlider, n5)
		end

		if type(tbl6.syncCalibrationStatus) == "function" then
			pcall(tbl6.syncCalibrationStatus)
		end

		tbl6.wakeOverlay("speed-calibration")
	end

	tbl6.reconcileCarryLossSnapshot = function(arg)

					else

						end

							tbl17.deathRecoveryMissingAt = os.clock()

					end
				end

					armDroppedEggReacquire(lastDroppedUid, "full snapshot confirmed dropped egg", record)

	end

	devChickenTween.move = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6)

		if not lease or not devChickenTween.alive(lease) then

		end
		local tbl25 = {}

		local ok3, result3, result4 = pcall(function()
			devChickenTween.stopTween(lease, true)
			local v9 = lease
			local v10 = lease

			end

			end

			if arg4 and arg4() then
				return true
			end
			local magnitude = (arg - lease.root.Position).Magnitude
			if magnitude <= (arg2 or 0.35) then
				return true
			end
			local n4 = magnitude / lease.speed
			local n5 = os.clock() + n4 + 4
			local v14 = lease
			local v15 = lease
			local position = lease.root.Position
			local now3 = os.clock()
			v14.observed = position
			v15.observedAt = now3
			lease.pendingTweenSpeed = nil
			local rotation = lease.root.CFrame.Rotation
			lease.tween = TweenService:Create(lease.root, TweenInfo.new(n4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = CFrame.new(arg) * rotation })
			lease.holdCFrame = nil
			lease.tween:Play()
			local now4 = nil

			while devChickenTween.alive(lease) and lease.ticket == tbl25 and not lease.cancelled do
				lease.lastUse = os.clock()
				if not arg3() or arg5 and arg5() then
					return false, "cancelled"
				end

				if arg4 and arg4() then
					return true
				end

				if (lease.root.Position - arg).Magnitude <= (arg2 or 0.35) then
					return true
				end
				local playbackState = lease.tween and lease.tween.PlaybackState
				if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled then
					return false, "engine tween cancelled"
				end

				if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
					now4 = now4 or os.clock()
					if math.clamp((tbl6.clientFrameSeconds or 0.016666666666666666) * 3, 0.08, 0.25) <= os.clock() - now4 then
						return false, "tween ended away from goal"
					end
				end

				if n5 <= os.clock() then
					return false, "movement timeout"
				end
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end

			if lease.stopReason then
				return false, lease.stopReason
			end

			if lease.ticket ~= tbl25 then
				return false, "tween superseded"
			end

			if localPlayer.Character ~= lease.character then
				return false, "character changed"
			end

			if lease.original.Health <= 0 or lease.temporary.Health <= 0 then
				return false, "character died"
			end

			if lease.root.Anchored then
				return false, "character anchored"
			end

			if tbl18.owner ~= lease.owner then
				return false, "movement ownership lost"
			end
			return false, "tween rig released"
		end)

		if not ok3 then
			if devChickenTween.lease == lease and lease.ticket == tbl25 then
				devChickenTween.restore("tween error: " .. tostring(result3))
			end

			return false, tostring(result3)
		end

		if devChickenTween.lease == lease and lease.ticket == tbl25 then
			local ok4, result5 = pcall(devChickenTween.stopTween, lease, true)
			if not ok4 then
				devChickenTween.restore("tween cleanup failed")
				return false, tostring(result5)
			end
		end

		return result3, result4
	end

	devChickenTween.groundMove = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6)
		if not devChickenTween.lease then
			return false, "development rig unavailable"
		end
		return devChickenTween.move(Vector3.new(arg.X, fn45(arg.X, arg.Z, arg.Y) or arg.Y, arg.Z), arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6 or 500)
	end

	devChickenTween.pickupHeightReady = function(arg)
		local lease = devChickenTween.lease
		if not lease then
			return true
		end
		local y = fn45(arg.X, arg.Z, arg.Y) or arg.Y

	end

	devChickenTween.recoverDrop = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		if not arg3() or arg5 and arg5() then
			return false, "cancelled"

		local v9, v10 = devChickenTween.begin(devChickenTween.lease and devChickenTween.lease.delivery)

			return false, v10
		end
		local lease = devChickenTween.lease

		lease.returnHeight = lease.returnHeight or math.max(lease.root.Position.Y, y + 21)
		devChickenTween.phase = "drop descent"
		local v11, v12 = devChickenTween.move(Vector3.new(lease.root.Position.X, y, lease.root.Position.Z), 0.35, arg3, nil, arg5, 500)
		if not v11 then
			return false, v12
		end
		devChickenTween.phase = "drop approach"
		return devChickenTween.move(Vector3.new(arg.X, y, arg.Z), arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, 500)
	end

	devChickenTween.launch = function(arg, arg2)
		local Tween = tbl6.getDeliverySpeed("Tween")
		if not arg.hitAttempted or not arg2() then
			return false, "chicken hit required"
		end
		local v9, v10 = devChickenTween.begin()
		if not v9 then
			return false, v10
		end
		tbl6.recoverChickenLanding(arg)
		local flag3 = tbl4.BurstTween == true
		local position = arg.root.Position
		local vector = Vector3.new(arg.targetPosition.X, fn45(arg.targetPosition.X, arg.targetPosition.Z, position.Y) or position.Y, arg.targetPosition.Z)
		local n4 = vector - position
		local v11, v12

		if flag3 then
			devChickenTween.phase = "fast outbound"
			local v13, v14 = devChickenTween.move(n4.Magnitude > 2830 and position + n4.Unit * 2830 or vector, 0.35, arg2, nil, arg.abortFn, 5000)
			if not v13 then
				return false, v14
			end
			devChickenTween.phase = "target approach"
			v11, v12 = devChickenTween.move(vector, 0.35, arg2, nil, arg.abortFn, 500)
		else
			devChickenTween.phase = "outbound"
			v11, v12 = devChickenTween.move(vector, 0.35, arg2, nil, arg.abortFn, Tween)
		end

		if v11 then
			local v13 = devChickenTween
			local launches = devChickenTween.launches + 1
			devChickenTween.phase = "recovery wait"
			v13.launches = launches
			local n5 = arg.hitAt + 3.1
			arg.developmentReadyAt = math.max(os.clock(), n5)
		end

		return v11, v12
	end

	devChickenTween.returnHome = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local lease = devChickenTween.lease
		local v9 = tbl6.getTrackStart()
		if not lease or not v9 then
			return false, "development return unavailable"
		end
		local root = lease.root
		local stealRoute = tbl4.StealRoute
		local phase = stealRoute == "Fly"

		if phase then
			lease.returnHeight = lease.returnHeight or root.Position.Y + 21
			local returnHeight = lease.returnHeight
			devChickenTween.phase = "return lift"
			local getDeliverySpeed = tbl6.getDeliverySpeed
			local movementType = lease.movementType
			local v10, v11 = devChickenTween.move(Vector3.new(root.Position.X, returnHeight, root.Position.Z), 0.35, arg, nil, arg2, getDeliverySpeed(movementType))
			if not v10 then
				return false, v11
			end
			devChickenTween.phase = "raised return"
			local v12, v13 = devChickenTween.move(Vector3.new(v9.Position.X, returnHeight, v9.Position.Z), 0.35, arg, nil, arg2, tbl6.getDeliverySpeed(lease.movementType))
			if not v12 then
				return false, v13
			end
		end

		if stealRoute == "Turbo Hybrid" then
			local movementPhase = tbl6.movementPhase
			tbl6.movementPhase = "return"
			local ok3, result3 = pcall(tbl6.guardRoutePoints, root.Position, v9.Position, arg3)
			tbl6.movementPhase = movementPhase
			if not ok3 then
				return false, "guard route unavailable: " .. tostring(result3)
			end

			for _, v10 in ipairs(result3) do
				devChickenTween.phase = "guard evade"
				local v11, v12 = devChickenTween.groundMove(v10, 3.5, arg, nil, arg2, tbl6.getDeliverySpeed(lease.movementType))
				if not v11 then
					return false, v12
				end
			end
		end

		local v10 = devChickenTween
		phase = phase and "TrackStart descent"

		if not phase then
			phase = stealRoute == "Turbo Hybrid" and "guard return" or "direct return"
		end

		v10.phase = phase
		local v11, v12 = devChickenTween.groundMove(v9.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 0.35, arg, nil, arg2, tbl6.getDeliverySpeed(lease.movementType))
		if not v11 then
			return false, v12
		end

		if not devChickenTween.restore("waiting for claim") then
			return false, devChickenTween.reason
		end
		devChickenTween.phase = "claim wait"
		return true
	end

	tbl6.progressionTweenTo = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
		if arg ~= "Place" and arg ~= "Treadmill" then
			return false, "invalid progression owner"
		end

		if devChickenTween.lease then
			return false, "movement restoration pending"
		end

		if not arg4() then
			return false, "cancelled"
		end
		local v9 = fn36()
		if not v9 then
			return false, "character unavailable"
		end
		local vector = Vector3.new(arg2.X, fn45(arg2.X, arg2.Z, arg2.Y) or arg2.Y, arg2.Z)
		if (v9.Position - vector).Magnitude <= arg3 then
			return true
		end
		local v10, v11 = devChickenTween.begin(true, arg, arg4)
		if not v10 then
			return false, v11
		end
		local lease = devChickenTween.lease
		local ok3, result3, result4 = pcall(devChickenTween.move, vector, arg3, arg4, nil, nil, 500)
		if devChickenTween.lease == lease and not devChickenTween.restore("progression arrival") then
			return false, devChickenTween.reason
		end

		if not ok3 then
			return false, tostring(result3)
		end
		return result3, result4
	end

	tbl6.progressionHoldStep = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)

	local function fn67(arg)
		local tbl25 = {
			active = nil,
			retired = {},
			jumps = 0,
			baitJumps = 0,
			contactJumps = 0,
			baitApproaches = 0,
			contactApproaches = 0,
			hitReports = 0,
			stages = 0,
			completed = 0,
			lastReason = "idle",
		}

		local function fn68(arg2, arg3)
			return arg2 ~= nil and arg3 ~= nil and tostring(arg2) == tostring(arg3)
		end

		local function fn69(arg2)
			return type(arg2) == "table" and arg2.purpose == "chicken-bait"
		end

		local function fn70(arg2)
			local flag3 = tbl25.active == arg2 and arg.sessionAlive() and arg.selected() and arg.sameCharacter(arg2) and arg.owns() and arg2.keepGoing()

			if flag3 then
				flag3 = not (arg2.abortFn and arg2.abortFn())
			end

			return flag3 and not arg.wallClosed()
		end

		local function fn71(arg2, lastReason)
			if tbl25.active == arg2 then
				tbl25.active = nil
			end

			tbl25.retired[tostring(arg2.bait.Uid)] = arg.now() + 15
			tbl25.lastReason = lastReason

			if arg2.request then
				arg2.request.abandoned = not arg2.landedAt
			end
		end

		tbl25.isBait = function(arg2)
			if arg2 == nil then
				return false
			end
			local v9 = arg.pending()
			if fn69(v9) and fn68(v9.uid, arg2) then
				return true
			end

			if type(v9) == "table" and not fn69(v9) and fn68(v9.uid, arg2) then
				return false
			end

			if tbl25.active and fn68(tbl25.active.bait.Uid, arg2) then
				return true
			end
			local v10 = tbl25.retired[tostring(arg2)]
			if v10 and v10 > arg.now() then
				return true
			end
			tbl25.retired[tostring(arg2)] = nil
			return false
		end

		tbl25.observeCarry = function(arg2)
			if type(arg2) ~= "table" then
				return false
			end
			local v9 = arg.pending()
			if not fn69(v9) then
				return false
			end

			if arg2.IsCarrying == true then
				if not fn68(arg2.Uid, v9.uid) then
					return false
				end
				v9.carrySeen = true
				v9.carryActive = true
				v9.carryEndedSeen = false
				return true
			end

			if arg2.IsCarrying == false and (fn68(arg2.Uid, v9.uid) or arg2.Uid == nil and v9.carryActive == true) then
				v9.carryActive = false
				v9.carryEndedSeen = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end

		tbl25.servicePending = function()
			getgenv().__SCARLET_Mark_("chicken-service")
			local v9 = arg.pending()
			if not fn69(v9) or tbl25.active and tbl25.active.request == v9 then
				return false
			end

			if v9.inFlight or v9.cleanupInFlight then
				return true
			end

			if not arg.requestCharacterAlive(v9) then
				arg.release(v9)
				return false
			end
			local uid = v9.uid

			if fn68(arg.heldUid(), uid) then
				local cleanupRetryAt = v9.cleanupRetryAt or 0
				if arg.now() < cleanupRetryAt then
					return true
				end

				if (v9.cleanupAttempts or 0) >= 3 then
					tbl25.retired[tostring(v9.uid)] = nil
					tbl25.lastReason = "bait drop rejected; ordinary carry recovery"
					arg.release(v9)
					return false
				end

				v9.cleanupAttempts = (v9.cleanupAttempts or 0) + 1
				v9.cleanupInFlight = true
				v9.inFlight = true

				arg.drop(v9, function()
					local v10 = v9
					v9.cleanupInFlight = false
					v10.inFlight = false
					v9.cleanupRetryAt = arg.now() + 0.75
					v9.proofDeadline = arg.now() + 1.5
				end)

				return true
			end

			local flag3 = v9.accepted and not v9.carryEndedSeen

			if flag3 then
				flag3 = arg.now() < (v9.proofDeadline or 0)
			end

			if flag3 then
				return true
			end
			arg.release(v9)
			return false
		end

		tbl25.observeClaim = function(arg2)
			local v9 = arg.pending()
			if not fn69(v9) or not v9.carrySeen then
				return false
			end
			local flag3 = type(arg2) == "table"

			if flag3 then
				flag3 = arg2.Uid or arg2.UID or arg2.EggUid
			end

			if flag3 ~= nil and not fn68(flag3, v9.uid) then
				return false
			end
			v9.claimSeen = true
			v9.carryEndedSeen = true
			v9.carryActive = false

			if tbl25.active and tbl25.active.request == v9 then
				tbl25.active.failure = "chicken bait was claimed"
			end

			return true
		end

		local function fn72(arg2)
			local v9 = arg.now()
			arg2.hitAttempted = true
			arg2.hitAt = v9
			if arg2.development and arg.travel then
				arg2.phase = "travel"
				return true
			end
			local v10, v11 = arg.relocate(arg2)
			if not v10 then
				arg2.failure = v11 or "chicken relocation failed"
				return false
			end
			arg2.landedAt = arg.now()
			arg2.phase = "landing"
			tbl25.jumps = tbl25.jumps + 1
			return true
		end

		tbl25.noteHit = function(arg2)
			local active = tbl25.active
			local hitAttempted = not active or active.phase ~= "contact" or active.hitAttempted or not fn70(active) or type(arg2) ~= "table" or not arg.ourHit(arg2) or not fn68(arg2.EggUid, active.bait.Uid) or not active.request

			if not hitAttempted then
				local carrySeen = active.request.carrySeen

				if not carrySeen then
					local uid = active.bait.Uid
					carrySeen = fn68(arg.heldUid(), uid)
				end

				hitAttempted = not carrySeen
			end

			if hitAttempted or not arg.nearChicken(active) or not arg.targetAvailable(active.targetUid) then
				return false
			end
			return fn72(active)
		end

		tbl25.reportHit = function(arg2)
			local hitAttempted = tbl25.active ~= arg2 or not fn70(arg2) or arg2.phase ~= "contact" or arg2.hitAttempted or arg2.hitReportAttempted or not arg2.request or not arg2.request.carrySeen or arg2.request.carryEndedSeen
			local flag3

			if hitAttempted then
				flag3 = hitAttempted
			else
				local uid = arg2.bait.Uid
				flag3 = not fn68(arg.heldUid(), uid)
			end

			if flag3 or not arg.targetAvailable(arg2.targetUid) then
				return false, "bait hit report unavailable"
			end
			arg2.hitReportAttempted = true
			local ok3, result3, result4 = pcall(arg.reportHit, arg2)
			if not ok3 or not result3 then
				return false, ok3 and (result4 or "bait hit report failed") or tostring(result3)
			end
			arg2.hitReportedAt = arg.now()
			tbl25.hitReports = tbl25.hitReports + 1
			if not fn70(arg2) then
				return false, "bait hit report cancelled"
			end

			if arg2.hitAttempted then
				return not arg2.failure, arg2.failure
			end
			local failure = arg2.failure
			return fn72(arg2), failure
		end

		tbl25.pickupDelay = function(arg2, arg3)
			local landing = tbl25.landing
			local flag3 = landing and fn68(landing.uid, arg2) and arg.requestCharacterAlive(landing)

			if flag3 then
				local readyAt = landing.readyAt
				flag3 = arg.now() >= readyAt
			end

			if flag3 then
				return 0
			end
			return arg3
		end

		tbl25.isLandingProtected = function(arg2)
			local active = tbl25.active

			if active and active.development and active.phase == "travel" and active.hitAt then
				local flag3 = active.character == arg2 and not active.failure and fn70(active)

				if flag3 then
					local hitAt = active.hitAt
					flag3 = arg.now() - hitAt < 30
				end

				return flag3
			end

			local flag3 = active ~= nil and active.phase == "landing" and active.landedAt ~= nil and not active.failure and active.character == arg2

			if flag3 then
				local landedAt = active.landedAt
				flag3 = arg.now() - landedAt <= 3.5
			end

			return flag3 and fn70(active)
		end

		tbl25.maintainLanding = function()
			local active = tbl25.active
			if not active or active.phase ~= "landing" or active.failure or not fn70(active) then
				return false
			end
			local ok3, result3, result4 = pcall(arg.hold, active)
			if not ok3 or not result3 then
				active.failure = ok3 and (result4 or "landing interrupted") or tostring(result3)
				return false
			end
			return true
		end

		tbl25.move = function(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7)
			if not arg.selected() then
				return nil
			end
			tbl25.retired[tostring(arg2)] = nil
			if arg6 and arg6() then
				return true
			end

			if not arg.targetAvailable(arg2) or arg.heldUid() ~= nil then
				return false, "target unavailable"
			end

			if tbl25.servicePending() or arg.pending() ~= nil then
				return false, "carry request busy"
			end
			local landing = tbl25.landing
			local v9 = landing and fn68(landing.uid, arg2) and arg.requestCharacterAlive(landing)
			local flag3

			if v9 then
				local readyAt = landing.readyAt
				flag3 = arg.now() >= readyAt
			else
				flag3 = v9
			end

			if flag3 then
				local readyAt = landing.readyAt
				flag3 = arg.now() - readyAt <= 6
			end

			if flag3 and arg.retryingTarget(arg2) then
				tbl25.lastReason = "confirmed landing; local pickup retry"

	tbl6.startStealSupervisor = function(arg)

		if stealSupervisorThread and coroutine.running() ~= stealSupervisorThread then

		if arg then
			warn("[Scarlet-SAE][steal] supervisor restarted: " .. tostring(arg))
		end

		return tbl6.stealSupervisorThread
	end

tbl6.recoveryTargetReclaimable = function(arg)
	if arg == nil then
		return false
	end
	local v8 = fn27(arg)
	if not v8 or v8.BottomCFrame == nil then
		return false
	end
	local str = tostring(v8.State)
	if str ~= "Slot" and str ~= "Dropped" then
		return false
	end
	local num = tonumber(v8.CarrierUserId)
	if num ~= nil and num > 0 and num ~= localPlayer.UserId then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

				str = v12
			end

			if critical then
				now3 = now5
			end

			local n3 = now5 - (tonumber(tbl18.stealBeat) or 0)
			local str7

			if stealWatchdog.beatSeconds < n3 then
				str7 = string.format("worker heartbeat stopped for %.0fs", n3)
			else
				local flag2 = not critical and now5 - now3 >= n2 and now5 - now4 >= n2
				str7 = nil

				if flag2 then
					str7 = string.format("no egg and no progress for %.0fs", now5 - now4)
				end
			end

			str7 = str7 and tbl6.resetAutoSteal(str7)

			if str7 then
				now3 = os.clock()
				now4 = os.clock()
				str = ""
				v8 = nil
			else
				v8 = position
			end
		end
	end
end)

tbl6.ragdollGuard = {
	active = false,
	conn = nil,
	events = 0,
	lastAt = 0,
	lastReason = nil,
	recent = {},
	cooldown = 0.4,
}

tbl6.ragdollStates = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true,
}

tbl6.clearRagdoll = function()
	local character = localPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (humanoid and humanoidRootPart) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	pcall(function()
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid.Sit = false

		if tbl6.ragdollStates[humanoid:GetState()] then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		local assemblyLinearVelocity = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity

		if Vector3.new(assemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, assemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude > 90 then
			humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(assemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
		end

		humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)

	for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BodyVelocity") or descendant:IsA("BodyThrust") or descendant:IsA("BodyGyro") or descendant:IsA("LinearVelocity") or descendant:IsA("AngularVelocity") then
			pcall(function()
				descendant:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("Motor6D") and not descendant.Enabled then
			pcall(function()
				descendant.Enabled = true
			end)
		end
	end

	for _, v8 in ipairs({ "Ragdoll", "Ragdolled", "IsRagdoll", "Downed", "KnockedBack" }) do
		pcall(function()
			if character:GetAttribute(v8) then
				character:SetAttribute(v8, false)
			end
		end)
	end

	return true
end

tbl6.noteRagdoll = function(arg)
	local ragdollGuard = tbl6.ragdollGuard
	local now3 = os.clock()
	if now3 - (tonumber(ragdollGuard.lastAt) or 0) < (tonumber(ragdollGuard.cooldown) or 0.4) then
		tbl6.clearRagdoll()
		return false
	end
	ragdollGuard.events = (tonumber(ragdollGuard.events) or 0) + 1
	ragdollGuard.lastAt = now3
	ragdollGuard.lastReason = tostring(arg)
	tbl6.clearRagdoll()
	tbl6.movementPhase = nil
	tbl18.stealBeat = now3

	if fn15 then
		pcall(fn15, "ragdoll-recovery")
	end

	warn("[Scarlet-SAE][steal] ragdoll cleared (" .. tostring(arg) .. ")")
	local recent = ragdollGuard.recent
	recent[#recent + 1] = now3

	while #recent > 0 and now3 - recent[1] > 8 do
		table.remove(recent, 1)
	end

	if #recent >= 4 and type(tbl6.resetAutoSteal) == "function" then
		table.clear(recent)
		pcall(tbl6.resetAutoSteal, "ragdolled " .. #recent .. " times in 8s")
	end

	return true
end

tbl6.setRagdollGuard = function(arg)
	local ragdollGuard = tbl6.ragdollGuard

	if arg and tbl4.RagdollRecovery == false then
		arg = false
	end

	if arg == ragdollGuard.active then
		return
	end
	ragdollGuard.active = arg and true or false

	if ragdollGuard.conn then
		pcall(function()
			ragdollGuard.conn:Disconnect()
		end)

		ragdollGuard.conn = nil
	end

	if not ragdollGuard.active then
		table.clear(ragdollGuard.recent)
		return
	end

	ragdollGuard.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not ragdollGuard.active then
			return
		end

		if not fn() then
			tbl6.setRagdollGuard(false)
			return
		end
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local state = humanoid:GetState()

		if tbl6.ragdollStates[state] or humanoid.PlatformStand == true then
			tbl6.noteRagdoll(humanoid.PlatformStand and "platform stand" or tostring(state))
		end
	end)
end

tbl6.shiftLockControl = { active = false, savedDev = nil, savedButton = nil }

tbl6.setShiftLockOff = function(arg)
	local shiftLockControl = tbl6.shiftLockControl

	if arg and tbl4.DisableShiftLockDuringSteal == false then
		arg = false
	end

	if arg == shiftLockControl.active then
		return
	end

	if not arg then
		shiftLockControl.active = false

		pcall(function()
			localPlayer.DevEnableMouseLock = shiftLockControl.savedDev ~= false
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
			playerGui = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("ShiftLockButton")

			if playerGui and shiftLockControl.savedButton ~= nil then
				playerGui.Enabled = shiftLockControl.savedButton
			end
		end)

		shiftLockControl.savedDev = nil
		shiftLockControl.savedButton = nil
		return
	end

	shiftLockControl.savedDev = localPlayer.DevEnableMouseLock

	pcall(function()
		localPlayer.DevEnableMouseLock = false
	end)

	pcall(function()
		local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		playerGui = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("ShiftLockButton")

		if playerGui then
			shiftLockControl.savedButton = playerGui.Enabled
			playerGui.Enabled = false
		end
	end)

	shiftLockControl.active = true
end

getgenv().__SCARLET_ShiftLockRestore = function()
	pcall(tbl6.setShiftLockOff, false)
end

tbl6.followAntiAFK = function(arg)
	if tbl4.AutoAntiAFKWithSteal == false then
		return false
	end

	if not arg then
		return false
	end

	if tbl4.AntiAFK == true then
		return false
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 20 do
			local scarletConfigControllers = getgenv().__SCARLET_ConfigControllers
			local antiAFK = type(scarletConfigControllers) == "table" and scarletConfigControllers.AntiAFK or nil
			if antiAFK then
				pcall(antiAFK.SetValue, antiAFK, true)
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)

	return true
end

tbl6.escapeGuard = { active = false, conn = nil, escapes = 0, lastAt = 0, cooldown = 2 }

tbl6.escapeHome = function(arg)
	if tbl4.EscapeOnHit == false then
		return false
	end
	local escapeGuard = tbl6.escapeGuard
	local now3 = os.clock()
	if now3 - (tonumber(escapeGuard.lastAt) or 0) < (tonumber(escapeGuard.cooldown) or 2) then
		return false
	end
	local v8 = tbl6.getTrackStart()
	if not (v8 and v8:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return false
	end
	local v9, v10 = fn36()
	if not (v9 and v10) or v10.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	escapeGuard.lastAt = now3
	escapeGuard.escapes = (tonumber(escapeGuard.escapes) or 0) + 1
	pcall(tbl6.clearRagdoll)

	pcall(function()

		v9.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		v9.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end)

	tbl6.movementPhase = nil
	tbl18.stealBeat = os.clock()
	pcall(fn14, "Hit - running home (" .. tostring(arg) .. ")")

tbl6.setEscapeGuard = function(arg)

	local v8 = nil

end

tbl6.dropHeldEgg = function()
	local rfEggWorldAskFieldEggDrop

	pcall(function()
		local packages = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
		packages = packages and packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
		rfEggWorldAskFieldEggDrop = packages and packages:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFieldEggDrop")
	end)

	local flag = not rfEggWorldAskFieldEggDrop

	if flag then
		pcall(function()
			local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
			local value = type(Remotes) == "table" and rawget(Remotes, "EggWorld") or nil
			local value2 = type(value) == "table" and rawget(value, "AskFieldEggDrop") or nil

			if typeof(value2) == "Instance" then
				rfEggWorldAskFieldEggDrop = value2
			end
		end)
	end

	if flag then
		return false, "drop remote unavailable"
	end

	local ok = pcall(function()
		return rfEggWorldAskFieldEggDrop:InvokeServer()
	end)

	return ok, ok and "dropped" or "drop refused"
end

tbl6.guardClosingIn = function(arg)
	if not arg then
		return false
	end
	local nearestGuardAt = tbl6.nearestGuardAt
	if type(nearestGuardAt) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, result, result2 = pcall(nearestGuardAt, arg.Position)
	if not ok or type(result2) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end

	if (tonumber(tbl4.StealDropGuardDistance) or 45) < result2 then
		return false
	end
	local guardCanCatch = tbl6.guardCanCatch
	local flag = true

	if type(guardCanCatch) == "function" then
		local ok2, result3 = pcall(guardCanCatch, result)
		local flag2 = true

		if ok2 then
			flag = result3 == true
		else
			flag = flag2
		end
	end

	if not flag then
		return false
	end
	return true, result, result2
end

end)
