	local function fn50(arg)
		local str = arg:lower()
		if not (str:find("scramble", 1, true) or str:find("event", 1, true) or str:find("experiment", 1, true)) then
			return false
		end

		for _, v8 in ipairs(tbl20) do
			if str:find(v8) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn51()
		getgenv().__SCARLET_Mark_("event-timer-scan")
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 - (tonumber(droneFarm.timerCheckedAt) or 0) < 1.5 then
			return droneFarm.timerResult
		end
		droneFarm.timerCheckedAt = now3
		local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		if not playerGui then
			droneFarm.timerResult = false
			return false
		end
		local n2 = 4000

		for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child.Enabled then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return child:GetDescendants()
				end)

				if ok and type(result) == "table" then
					for _, v8 in ipairs(result) do
						n2 -= 1
						if n2 <= 0 then
							break
						end

						if v8:IsA("TextLabel") and v8.Visible and v8.Text ~= "" and fn50(v8.Text) then
							droneFarm.timerResult = true
							droneFarm.timerText = v8.Text
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if n2 <= 0 then
				break
			end
		end

		droneFarm.timerResult = false
		return false
	end

	local function fn52()
		local scrambleLocalVisuals = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleLocalVisuals")
		if not scrambleLocalVisuals then
			return false
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(scrambleLocalVisuals:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") and child.Name:sub(1, 13) == "PersonalDrone" and fn47(child) > 0 then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn53()
		if fn52() then
			return true
		end

		if fn51() then
			return true
		end

		if os.clock() - (tonumber(droneFarm.eventSeenAt) or 0) < (tonumber(droneFarm.trafficWindow) or 20) then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local fn54 = nil

	fn54 = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		arg2 = arg2 or 0
		arg3 = arg3 or {}
		if arg2 > 4 then
			return arg3
		end
		local kind = typeof(arg)

		if kind == "string" then
			arg3[#arg3 + 1] = arg
		elseif kind == "number" or kind == "boolean" then
			arg3[#arg3 + 1] = tostring(arg)
		elseif kind == "Instance" then
			arg3[#arg3 + 1] = arg.Name
		elseif kind == "table" then
			for k, v8 in pairs(arg) do
				if type(k) == "string" then
					arg3[#arg3 + 1] = k
				end

				fn54(v8, arg2 + 1, arg3)
			end
		end

		return arg3
	end

	local tbl21 = {
		"running an experiment",
		"dr. scramble",
		"dr scramble",
		"scramble",
		"drone",
		"experiment",
		"brock",
		"vault",
		"lost part",
	}

	local function fn55(arg)
		local str = arg:lower()

		for _, v8 in ipairs(tbl21) do
			if str:find(v8, 1, true) then
				return true, v8
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn56(arg)
		local tbl22 = {}

		if arg:IsA("TextLabel") or arg:IsA("TextButton") then
			tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = arg.Text
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return arg:GetDescendants()
		end)

		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			for _, v8 in ipairs(result) do
				if v8:IsA("TextLabel") or v8:IsA("TextButton") then
					tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = v8.Text
				end
			end
		end

		return table.concat(tbl22, " | ")
	end

	local function fn57(arg, arg2)
		if not arg then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			arg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				getgenv().__SCARLET_Mark_("banner-watch")

				task.spawn(function()
					for i = 1, 8 do
						task.wait(0.1)
						if not (child and child.Parent) then
							return
						end
						local v8 = fn56(child)
						if v8 == "" then
							continue
						end

						if droneFarm.announceLog then
							warn("[Scarlet-SAE][notice] banner/" .. arg2 .. ": " .. v8:sub(1, 300))
						end

						local v9, v10 = fn55(v8)

						if v9 then
							local sub = v8.sub
							droneFarm.onAnnouncement("banner:" .. tostring(v10), sub(v8, 1, 160))
							return
						end
					end
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end

	droneFarm.onAnnouncement = function(arg, arg2)
		local v8 = tostring
		droneFarm.lastAnnounce = ("[%s] %s"):format(tostring(arg), v8(arg2))
		droneFarm.eventSeenAt = os.clock()
		if droneFarm.autoArm ~= true then
			return
		end

		if droneFarm.armed then
			return
		end

		if droneFarm.toggle and type(droneFarm.toggle.SetValue) == "function" then
			pcall(droneFarm.toggle.SetValue, droneFarm.toggle, true)
		else
			droneFarm.arm()
		end

		v:Notify("Scramble event announced - drone farm armed.", 7)
		warn("[Scarlet-SAE][drones] armed by announcement: " .. tostring(droneFarm.lastAnnounce))
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		for _, v8 in ipairs({ { "Scramble", "Drones" }, { "Scramble", "State" }, { "Scramble", "Effect" } }) do
			local v9 = fn44(v8[1], v8[2])

			if v9 and v9:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				pcall(function()
					v9.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
						droneFarm.eventSeenAt = os.clock()

						if droneFarm.autoArm and not droneFarm.armed then
							droneFarm.onAnnouncement("RE/Scramble/" .. v8[2], "drone traffic")
						end
					end)
				end)
			end
		end

		local Broadcasts = fn44("Broadcasts", "RaiseNotice")

		if Broadcasts and Broadcasts:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			pcall(function()
				Broadcasts.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
					local str = table.concat(fn54({ ... }), " | ")

					if droneFarm.announceLog then
						warn("[Scarlet-SAE][notice] " .. str:sub(1, 400))
					end

					local v8, v9 = fn55(str)

					if v8 then
						droneFarm.onAnnouncement("RaiseNotice:" .. tostring(v9), str:sub(1, 160))
					end
				end)
			end)
		end

		local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		local notifications = playerGui and playerGui:WaitForChild("Notifications", 30)

		if notifications then
			fn57(notifications:FindFirstChild("MessageTop"), "MessageTop")
			fn57(notifications:FindFirstChild("Bottom"), "Bottom")

			pcall(function()
				notifications.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
					if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
						fn57(child, child.Name)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end

		local playerGui2 = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		playerGui2 = playerGui2 and playerGui2:WaitForChild("DrScrambleEventUI", 30)

		if playerGui2 then
			pcall(function()
				playerGui2:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Open"):Connect(function()
					if playerGui2:GetAttribute("Open") == true then
						droneFarm.onAnnouncement("DrScrambleEventUI", "panel opened")
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end)

	local function fn58(arg)
		local v8 = fn36()
		if not v8 then
			return nil
		end
		local v9 = nil
		local v10 = nil

		for _, v11 in ipairs(fn49()) do
			local parent = v11.health > 0 and v11.model.Parent

			if parent then
				parent = not (arg and arg[v11.model])
			end

			if parent then
				local magnitude = ((v11.position - v8.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude

				if magnitude <= droneFarm.scanRadius then
					local health = droneFarm.targetHighestHp and v11.health or magnitude

					if v9 == nil or droneFarm.targetHighestHp and health > v9 or not droneFarm.targetHighestHp and health < v9 then
						v9 = health
						v10 = v11
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return v10
	end

	local function fn59()
		local guardAreas = workspace:FindFirstChild("GuardAreas", true)
		local tbl22 = {}
		if not guardAreas then
			return tbl22
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(guardAreas:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return child:GetPivot().Position
				end)

				result = ok and result or nil

				if not result then
					result = child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					result = result and result.Position or nil
				end

				if result then
					local attribute = nil

					pcall(function()
						attribute = child:GetAttribute("GuardEscapeSpeeds")
					end)

					local x = typeof(attribute) == "Vector2" and attribute.X
					local huge

					if x then
						huge = x
					else
						huge = typeof(attribute) == "number" and attribute or math.huge
					end

					tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = { name = child.Name, position = result, order = huge }
				end
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl22, function(arg, arg2)
			return arg.order < arg2.order
		end)

		return tbl22
	end

	local function fn60()
		local tbl22 = {}
		local v8 = fn59()

		for i = #v8, 1, -1 do
			tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = v8[i].name
		end

		return tbl22
	end

	local function fn61()
		local v8 = fn59()
		if #v8 == 0 then
			return v8
		end
		local order = v8[#v8].order
		local str = tostring(droneFarm.finalArea or "")

		if str ~= "" and str:lower() ~= "all the way" then
			for _, v9 in ipairs(v8) do
				if v9.name:lower() == str:lower() then
					order = v9.order
					break
				end
			end
		end

		local tbl22 = {}

		for _, v9 in ipairs(v8) do
			if v9.order <= order then
				tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = v9
			end
		end

		local v9 = fn36()

		if v9 then
			local huge = math.huge
			local n2 = 1

			for i, v10 in ipairs(tbl22) do
				local magnitude = ((v10.position - v9.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude

				if magnitude < huge then
					huge = magnitude
					n2 = i
				end
			end

			local tbl23 = {}

			for i = n2, #tbl22 do
				tbl23[#tbl23 + 1] = tbl22[i]
			end

			return tbl23
		end

		return tbl22
	end

	local function fn62()
		local str = tostring(droneFarm.scanFrom or "")
		if str == "" then
			return -math.huge
		end

		for _, v8 in ipairs(fn59()) do
			if v8.name:lower() == str:lower() then
				return v8.order
			end
		end

		return -math.huge
	end

	local function fn63()
		if tbl6.progressionHoldActive and tbl6.progressionHoldActive() then
			return true
		end

		if type(tbl6.progressionHoldBegin) ~= "function" then
			return false, "movement controller still starting"
		end

		if tbl18.owner ~= "Place" then
			if not tbl18.acquireWait("Place", 6) then
				return false, "waiting for " .. tostring(tbl18.owner or "the body")
			end
		end

		return tbl6.progressionHoldBegin("Place", function()
			return droneFarm.running and fn()
		end)
	end

	local function fn64(arg)
		if type(tbl6.progressionHoldRelease) == "function" then
			pcall(tbl6.progressionHoldRelease, arg or "drone farm finished")
		end

		if tbl18.owner == "Place" then
			pcall(tbl18.release, "Place")
		end
	end

	local function fn65(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local v8, v9 = fn63()
		if not v8 then
			return false, v9
		end
		local ok, result, result2 = pcall(tbl6.progressionHoldStep, arg, tonumber(arg2) or 6, arg3, droneFarm.moveSpeed)
		if not ok then
			return false, tostring(result)
		end
		return result, result2
	end

	local function fn66()
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return nil
		end
		return character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
	end

	local function fn67()
		local tbl22 = {}

		for _, v8 in ipairs({ localPlayer.Character, localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") }) do
			if v8 then
				for _, child in ipairs(v8:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") then
						local ok, result = pcall(function()
							return child:GetAttribute("IsBat")
						end)

						if ok and result == true or child.Name:lower():find("bat", 1, true) then
							tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = child
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return tbl22
	end

	local function fn68()
		local Codex = fn44("Codex", "AskWearFieldBat")
		if not Codex then
			return false
		end

		local ok = pcall(function()
			return Codex:InvokeServer()
		end)

		if ok then
			task.wait(0.25)
		end

		return ok
	end

	local function fn69()
		local v8 = fn67()

		if #v8 == 0 then
			fn68()
			v8 = fn67()
			if #v8 == 0 then
				return nil
			end
		end

		local v9 = nil

		for _, v10 in ipairs(v8) do
			if v10.Parent == localPlayer.Character then
				v9 = v10
				break
			else
				v9 = nil
			end
		end

		local function fn70(arg)
			local attribute = nil

			pcall(function()
				attribute = arg:GetAttribute("CooldownActive")
			end)

			if attribute == false or attribute == nil then
				return true
			end
			local num = nil

			pcall(function()
				num = tonumber(arg:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime"))
			end)

			return num ~= nil and num > 0 and os.time() >= num
		end

		if v9 and fn70(v9) then
			return v9
		end
		local v10, v11 = fn36()
		if not v11 then
			return v9
		end

		for _, v12 in ipairs(v8) do
			if v12 ~= v9 and fn70(v12) then
				if pcall(function()
					v11:EquipTool(v12)
				end) then
					droneFarm.swaps = droneFarm.swaps + 1
					return v12
				end
			end
		end

		local flag = not v9

		if flag and v8[1] then
			pcall(function()
				v11:EquipTool(v8[1])
			end)
		end

		if flag and #v8 == 0 then
			return fn66()
		end
		return v9 or v8[1]
	end

	local function fn70()
		local v8 = fn69()

		if v8 then
			pcall(function()
				v8:Activate()
			end)
		end

		local BatSwing = fn44("BatSwing", "Trigger")
		if not BatSwing then
			droneFarm.swings = droneFarm.swings + (v8 and 1 or 0)
			return v8 ~= nil
		end

		local ok = pcall(function()
			BatSwing:FireServer()
		end)

		if ok then
			droneFarm.swings = droneFarm.swings + 1
		end

		return ok
	end

	local function fn71(arg)
		getgenv().__SCARLET_Mark_("drone-fight")
		local droneTimeout = droneFarm.dryRun and (tonumber(droneFarm.testTrackSeconds) or 10) or droneFarm.droneTimeout
		local n2 = os.clock() + droneTimeout
		local health = arg.health
		local v8 = nil
		local vector = Vector3.zero
		local v9 = nil
		local n3 = 0

		while droneFarm.running and os.clock() < n2 and fn() do
			local model = arg.model
			if not (model and model.Parent) then
				return true
			end
			local v10 = fn48(model)
			if not v10 then
				return true
			end
			local v11 = fn47(model)
			if v11 <= 0 then
				return true
			end
			local v12 = fn36()
			if not v12 then
				return false
			end

			if droneFarm.survival then
				local v13 = tbl6.droneHealthFraction()

				if v13 <= tbl6.droneSurvival.retreatAt then
					tbl6.droneSurvival.retreats = tbl6.droneSurvival.retreats + 1
					tbl6.droneSurvival.healing = true
					fn46(("backing off at %.0f%% health"):format(v13 * 100))
					local n4 = (v12.Position - v10.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

					if n4.Magnitude < 1 then
						n4 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
					end

					fn65(v10.Position + n4.Unit * 60, 8, function()
						return droneFarm.running and fn()
					end)

					local n5 = os.clock() + 20

					while true do
						if droneFarm.running and fn() and os.clock() < n5 then
							local resumeAt = tbl6.droneSurvival.resumeAt
							if not (tbl6.droneHealthFraction() >= resumeAt) then
								task.wait(0.25)
								continue
							end
						end

						break
					end

					tbl6.droneSurvival.healing = false
					n2 = os.clock() + droneTimeout
					v8 = nil
				end
			end

			local position = v10.Position

			if v8 then
				local n4 = position - v8

				if n4.Magnitude > 0.05 then
					vector = vector:Lerp(n4.Unit, 0.3)
				end
			end

			v8 = position
			local n4 = position

			if vector.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local lead = droneFarm.lead
				n4 = position + Vector3.new(vector.X, 0, vector.Z).Unit * lead
			end

			local magnitude = ((position - v12.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
			local progressionHoldActive = tbl6.progressionHoldActive and tbl6.progressionHoldActive() or false

			if magnitude > droneFarm.engage and (v9 == nil or (n4 - v9).Magnitude > 2 or not progressionHoldActive) then
				v9 = n4

				task.spawn(function()
					fn65(n4, math.max(1, droneFarm.engage - 1), function()
						if not (droneFarm.running and fn()) then
							return false
						end

						if not (model and model.Parent) then
							return false
						end

						if fn47(model) <= 0 then
							return false
						end
						local v13 = fn48(model)
						return not (v13 and (v13.Position - position).Magnitude > droneFarm.lead + 3)
					end)
				end)
			end

			local now3 = os.clock()

			if now3 >= n3 and magnitude <= droneFarm.engage + 6 then
				if not droneFarm.dryRun then
					fn70()
				end

				n3 = now3 + droneFarm.swingDelay
				fn46(("%s · %d hp · %d killed"):format(droneFarm.dryRun and "tracking (test)" or "hitting", v11, droneFarm.kills))
			end

			if v11 < health then
				droneFarm.damage = droneFarm.damage + 1
				n2 = os.clock() + droneTimeout
				health = v11
			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn72()
		local giveUp = droneFarm.giveUp
		local n2 = 0
		local n3 = 0

		while droneFarm.running and fn() do
			local v8 = fn58(giveUp)

			if v8 then
				droneFarm.seenAnyDrone = true

				if fn71(v8) then
					droneFarm.kills = droneFarm.kills + 1
					n3 += 1
				else
					giveUp[v8.model] = true
					fn46("gave up on a drone - moving to the next")
				end

				task.wait(0.1)
				n2 = 0

				if droneFarm.dryRun then
					droneFarm.testResult = ("reached the drones and tracked one for %ds, staying %g studs in front of the knockback. No swings sent."):format(tonumber(droneFarm.testTrackSeconds) or 10, droneFarm.lead)
					droneFarm.testDone = true
					return n3
				end

				continue
			end

			n2 += 1
			if droneFarm.emptyRescans <= n2 then
				return n3
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
		end

		return n3
	end

	droneFarm.endSweep = function(arg)
		if droneFarm.dryRun ~= true then
			if droneFarm.kills > 0 or droneFarm.damage > 0 then
				droneFarm.failures = 0
			else
				droneFarm.failures = (tonumber(droneFarm.failures) or 0) + 1
			end

			droneFarm.retryAt = os.clock() + math.min(30, 2 * (tonumber(droneFarm.failures) or 0))
		end

		droneFarm.running = false
		droneFarm.dryRun = false
		fn64(arg)
		droneFarm.restoreSteal()

		if not droneFarm.armed then
			pcall(tbl6.setDroneSurvival, false)
		end

		fn46(droneFarm.armed and "armed - " .. tostring(arg) or "idle (" .. tostring(arg) .. ")")
	end

	droneFarm.borrowSteal = function()
		if droneFarm.pauseSteal ~= true then
			return
		end

		if droneFarm.stealWasOn ~= nil then
			return
		end
		local stealWasOn = AutoStealToggle and AutoStealToggle.Value == true or tbl4.AutoSteal == true
		droneFarm.stealWasOn = stealWasOn
		if not stealWasOn then
			return
		end

		if AutoStealToggle and type(AutoStealToggle.SetValue) == "function" then
			pcall(AutoStealToggle.SetValue, AutoStealToggle, false)
		else
			pcall(function()
				tbl4.AutoSteal = false
			end)
		end

		fn46("paused Auto-Steal for the event")
		local n2 = os.clock() + 8

		while true do
			if os.clock() < n2 and fn() then
				if tbl18.stealBusy() then
					task.wait(0.2)
					continue
				end
			end

			break
		end
	end

	droneFarm.restoreSteal = function()
		local stealWasOn = droneFarm.stealWasOn
		droneFarm.stealWasOn = nil
		if stealWasOn ~= true then
			return
		end

		if AutoStealToggle and type(AutoStealToggle.SetValue) == "function" then
			pcall(AutoStealToggle.SetValue, AutoStealToggle, true)
		else
			pcall(function()
				tbl4.AutoSteal = true
			end)
		end
	end

	droneFarm.stop = function(arg)
		droneFarm.armed = false
		local v8 = droneFarm
		droneFarm.waitingSince = 0
		v8.lastWaitNotice = 0
		pcall(tbl6.droneUnphaseAll)
		droneFarm.endSweep(arg)
		pcall(tbl6.setDroneSurvival, false)

		if droneFarm.toggle then
			pcall(function()
				droneFarm.toggle:SetValue(false)
			end)
		end
	end

	droneFarm.sayOnce = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		droneFarm.said = droneFarm.said or {}
		local now3 = os.clock()
		local v8 = droneFarm.said[arg]
		local flag

		if v8 then
			flag = now3 - v8 < (tonumber(arg3) or 120)
		else
			flag = v8
		end

		if flag then
			return
		end
		droneFarm.said[arg] = now3
		v:Notify(arg2, 7)
	end

	droneFarm.run = function()
		getgenv().__SCARLET_Mark_("drone-sweep")

		if #fn67() == 0 and not droneFarm.dryRun then
			fn68()

			if #fn67() == 0 then
				local v8 = fn66()
				droneFarm.sayOnce("nobat", v8 and "No tool named as a bat. Swinging with " .. v8.Name .. " instead." or "No bat found. Running anyway - swings may not land.")
			end
		end

		if #fn67() == 1 then
			droneFarm.sayOnce("onebat", "Only one bat equipped - swing rate is halved by the cooldown. Carry a second and Scarlet rotates them.")
		end

		local v8 = fn61()

		if #v8 == 0 then
			fn46("no route - GuardAreas not loaded yet")
			droneFarm.endSweep("no route")
			return
		end

		local v9 = fn62()

		for _, v10 in ipairs(v8) do
			if droneFarm.running and fn() then
				if not droneFarm.testDone then
					local flag = v10.order >= v9
					fn46((flag and "scanning %s" or "passing %s"):format(v10.name))

					local function fn73()
						return flag and fn58(droneFarm.giveUp) ~= nil
					end

					local v11, v12 = fn65(v10.position, 14, function()
						return droneFarm.running and fn() and not fn73()
					end)

					if not v11 and v12 and v12 ~= "cancelled" then
						droneFarm.lastMoveIssue = tostring(v12)
						fn46(tostring(v12))
					end

					while true do
						if droneFarm.running and fn() and fn73() then
							fn72()

							if not droneFarm.testDone then
								if droneFarm.running and fn() then
									fn65(v10.position, 14, function()
										return droneFarm.running and fn() and not fn73()
									end)

									continue
								end
							end
						end

						break
					end

					if flag then
						fn72()
					end

					if droneFarm.testDone then
						break
					else
						continue
					end
				end
			end

			break
		end

		if not droneFarm.running then
			return
		end

		if droneFarm.dryRun then
			v:Notify("Drone test: " .. tostring(droneFarm.testResult or "ran the whole route and found no drones in range."), 10)
			fn46("test finished")
			droneFarm.endSweep("test finished")
			return
		end

		fn46("returning")
		local v10 = tbl6.getTrackStart()

		if v10 and v10:IsA("BasePart") then
			fn65(v10.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 6, function()
				return droneFarm.running and fn()
			end)
		end

		local str

		if droneFarm.lastMoveIssue and droneFarm.swings == 0 then
			str = "Could not move: " .. tostring(droneFarm.lastMoveIssue) .. ". Nothing was farmed."
		elseif droneFarm.swings == 0 then
			str = "Ran the whole route and never got in swinging range. Movement or detection, not the bat."
		elseif droneFarm.damage == 0 then
			str = ("Sent %d swings and no drone lost health. The swing remote is firing but not landing - it most likely needs arguments, or the held tool is not the event weapon."):format(droneFarm.swings)
		else
			str = ("Drone farm finished. %d killed, %d swings, %d bat swaps."):format(droneFarm.kills, droneFarm.swings, droneFarm.swaps)
		end

		droneFarm.sayOnce("report:" .. str:sub(1, 40), str, 30)
		warn("[Scarlet-SAE][drones] " .. str)

		if not droneFarm.seenAnyDrone and not fn51() then
			droneFarm.eventSeenAt = 0
			fn46("event over - waiting for the next one")
			droneFarm.endSweep("event over")
			return
		end

		droneFarm.endSweep("finished")
	end

	droneFarm.blockedReason = function()
		local v8
		v8, v8 = fn36()
		if not (v8 and v8.Health > 0) then
			return "waiting for character"
		end

		if droneFarm.eventOnly and not fn53() then
			return "armed - waiting for the event"
		end
		return nil
	end

	droneFarm.arm = function()
		if droneFarm.armed then
			return
		end
		droneFarm.armed = true

		if droneFarm.survival then
			pcall(tbl6.setDroneSurvival, true)
		end

		fn46("armed")

		task.spawn(function()
			while droneFarm.armed and fn() do
				if not droneFarm.running then
					local v8 = droneFarm.blockedReason()

					if v8 then
						fn46(v8)
						droneFarm.failures = 0
						local now3 = os.clock()

						if droneFarm.waitingSince == 0 then
							droneFarm.waitingSince = now3
						end

						if now3 - (tonumber(droneFarm.lastWaitNotice) or 0) >= 10 then
							droneFarm.lastWaitNotice = now3
							local n2 = math.floor(now3 - droneFarm.waitingSince)
							v:Notify(("Drone farm armed - %s (%ds)"):format(tostring(v8), n2), 4)
						end
					else
						local now3 = os.clock()

						if (tonumber(droneFarm.retryAt) or 0) <= now3 then
							local v9 = droneFarm
							droneFarm.waitingSince = 0
							v9.lastWaitNotice = 0
							droneFarm.start(false)
						end
					end
				end

				local n2 = tonumber(droneFarm.pollSeconds) or 2
				local n3 = tonumber(droneFarm.failures) or 0

				if n3 > 0 then
					n2 = math.min(30, 2 * n3)
				end

				task.wait(n2)
			end
		end)
	end

	droneFarm.start = function(arg)
		if droneFarm.running then
			return
		end
		droneFarm.running = true
		droneFarm.dryRun = arg == true
		droneFarm.testDone = false
		droneFarm.testResult = nil
		local v8 = droneFarm
		droneFarm.kills = 0
		v8.swaps = 0
		local v9 = droneFarm
		droneFarm.swings = 0
		v9.damage = 0
		droneFarm.giveUp = {}
		droneFarm.seenAnyDrone = false
		droneFarm.lastMoveIssue = nil

		if droneFarm.survival then
			pcall(tbl6.setDroneSurvival, true)
		end

		fn46(droneFarm.dryRun and "test run" or "starting")

		task.spawn(function()
			if not droneFarm.dryRun then
				droneFarm.borrowSteal()
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(droneFarm.run)

			if not ok then
				warn("[Scarlet-SAE][drones] " .. tostring(result))
				fn46("error: " .. tostring(result))
				droneFarm.endSweep("error")
			end
		end)
	end

					v:Notify(str, 10)

					local BatSwing = fn44("BatSwing", "Trigger")

					local value = rawget(getgenv(), "hookmetamethod")
					local value2 = rawget(getgenv(), "getnamecallmethod")

						v:Notify("This executor has no hookmetamethod.", 6)
						return
					end

					if droneFarm.swingHooked then
						v:Notify("Already hooked. Swing by hand and watch the console.", 6)
						return
					end
					droneFarm.swingHooked = true
					local v9 = nil

					local function fn75(arg, ...)
						local v10 = table.pack(...)

						if arg == BatSwing and value2() == "FireServer" then
							local tbl22 = { ... }
							local tbl23 = {}

							for i = 1, select("#", table.unpack(v10, 1, v10.n)) do
								local n2 = #tbl23 + 1
								local v11 = tostring
								local v12 = tbl22[i]
								tbl23[n2] = ("%d=%s(%s)"):format(i, typeof(tbl22[i]), v11(v12))
							end

							warn("[Scarlet-SAE][swing] FireServer " .. (tbl22.n == 0 and "<no arguments>" or table.concat(tbl23, " ")))
							return v9(arg, table.unpack(v10, 1, v10.n))
						end

						return v9(arg, ...)
					end

					v9 = value
					v9 = v9(game, "__namecall", fn75)
					v:Notify("Hooked. Swing the bat by hand once, then read the console.", 8)
				end,
			})
		end)

		pcall(function()
			diagnosticsSection:Button({
				Title = "Stop drone test",
				Desc = "Ends a test run and hands the body back.",
				Callback = function()
					if not droneFarm.running then
						v:Notify("No drone run in progress.", 5)
						return
					end
					droneFarm.stop("test stopped")
					v:Notify("Drone run stopped.", 5)
				end,
			})
		end)
	end
end

tbl6.stageAtTrackStart = function()
	if tbl4.StealStageOnEnable == false then
		return false
	end

	if critical then
		return false
	end
	local v8 = tbl6.getTrackStart()
	if not (v8 and v8:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return false
	end
	local v9, v10 = fn36()
	if not (v9 and v10 and v10.Health > 0) then
		return false
	end
	local n2 = v8.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	if ((v9.Position - n2) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude <= 6 then
		return false
	end
	fn14("Staging at return point")

	if not pcall(function()
		v9.CFrame = CFrame.new(n2)
		v9.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		v9.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end) then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		task.wait(0.12)

		if not (not fn() or tbl4.AutoSteal ~= true) then
			local v11 = fn36()

			if v11 then
				if not (((v11.Position - n2) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude <= 6) then
					pcall(function()
						v11.CFrame = CFrame.new(n2)
					end)

					continue
				end
			end
		end

		break
	end

	tbl18.stealBeat = os.clock()
	return true
end

AutoStealToggle:OnChanged(function(autoSteal)
	tbl4.AutoSteal = autoSteal
	tbl6.applyStealSessionMode(autoSteal)

	if fn15 then
		fn15(autoSteal and "enabled" or "disabled")
	end

	if autoSteal then
		task.spawn(function()
			if fn() and tbl4.AutoSteal == true then
				pcall(tbl6.stageAtTrackStart, "auto-steal enabled")
			end
		end)

		local v8, v9, v10 = tbl6.eggInventoryCapacityState()

		if v8 then
			tbl4.AutoSteal = false
			task.defer(tbl6.stopAutoStealForFullInventory, v9, v10, "Your egg inventory is full!")
			return
		end

		tbl6.inventoryFullStopped = false
		fn2(true)
		fn14("Waiting for target")
	else
		if tbl6.greatBloomUnlockNeedsCrane() then
			fn14("Great Bloom · finding Crane egg")

			if fn15 then
				fn15("great-bloom-unlock")
			end

			return
		end

		fn2(false)
		fn16()
		local scarletCarryRequest = getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest

		if type(scarletCarryRequest) == "table" and scarletCarryRequest.inFlight ~= true then
			getgenv().__SCARLET_CarryRequest = nil
		end

		local v8 = tbl18
		tbl18.stealWants = false
		v8.critical = false
		tbl18.release("Steal")
		tbl6.pauseStealTimer()
		tbl6.set("target", "Target: none")
		tbl6.carry = "Carry: none"
		tbl6.activeGuardAreaId = nil
		fn18()

		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait()
			if not fn() or tbl4.AutoSteal or critical then
				return
			end
			local v9 = tbl6.getTrackStart()
			local v10, v11 = fn36()
			if not (v9 and v10 and v11 and v11.Health > 0) then
				return
			end

			if ((v10.Position - v9.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude <= 3 then
				return
			end
			tbl18.stealWants = true

			if tbl18.acquireWait("Steal", 1) then
				fn14("Steal stopped · returning to TrackStart")

				tbl6.settleClaimAtTrackStart(function()
					return fn() and not tbl4.AutoSteal and not critical and tbl18.hold("Steal")
				end)

				tbl18.release("Steal")
			end

			tbl18.stealWants = false
			fn18()
		end)
	end
end)

		local function fn54(arg, arg2, arg3)
			if arg2 == "Front → Back" then
				table.sort(arg, function(arg4, arg5)
					if arg4.z ~= arg5.z then
						return arg4.z < arg5.z
					end
					return arg4.x < arg5.x
				end)
			elseif arg2 == "Edge → Inward" then
				local function fn55(arg4)
					return math.min(arg4.x - arg3.minx, arg3.maxx - arg4.x, arg4.z - arg3.minz, arg3.maxz - arg4.z)
				end

				table.sort(arg, function(arg4, arg5)
					return fn55(arg4) < fn55(arg5)
				end)
			elseif arg2 == "Center → Out" then
				local n5 = (arg3.minx + arg3.maxx) / 2
				local n6 = (arg3.minz + arg3.maxz) / 2

				table.sort(arg, function(arg4, arg5)
					return (arg4.x - n5) ^ 2 + (arg4.z - n6) ^ 2 < (arg5.x - n5) ^ 2 + (arg5.z - n6) ^ 2
				end)
			else
				table.sort(arg, function(arg4, arg5)
					if arg4.z ~= arg5.z then
						return arg4.z > arg5.z
					end
					return arg4.x < arg5.x
				end)
			end

			return arg
		end

		local function fn59(arg, arg2, arg3)
			local function fn60(arg4, arg5, arg6)
				local function fn61()
					return fn() and not critical and tbl18.sellOk() and tbl6.sellerValueFilterReady("SellEggValueThreshold") and (not arg6 or tbl4[arg6] == true)
				end

				if not fn61() then

				end

				if not (petSatchel and petSatchel.SellSelection) then
					return 0, 0, #arg4
				end
				local tbl25 = {}
				local tbl26 = {}
				local tbl27 = {}
				local tbl28 = {}

					local str = tostring(v12.uid)

					if tbl25[str] and not tbl28[str] and not tbl6.riftEggReserved(str) then
						if not (arg5 and #tbl27 >= arg5) then
							local n2 = #tbl26 + 1
							local n3 = #tbl27 + 1
							tbl26[n2] = v12
							tbl27[n3] = str
							tbl28[str] = true
							continue
						end
					else
						continue
					end

					break
				end

				if #tbl27 == 0 or not fn61() then
					return 0, 0, 0
				end

				local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
					return tbl20.Get()
				end)

				if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" or type(result2.EggInventory) ~= "table" then
					return 0, 0, #tbl26
				end
				local tbl29 = {}

				for k in pairs(result2.EggInventory) do
					tbl29[tostring(k)] = true
				end

				local tbl30 = {}

				for _, v12 in ipairs(fn58(tbl25)) do
					tbl30[tostring(v12.uid)] = v12
				end

				local tbl31 = {}
				local tbl32 = {}
				table.clear(tbl28)

				for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl27) do
					if tbl29[v12] and tbl30[v12] and not tbl6.riftEggReserved(v12) then
						local n2 = #tbl31 + 1
						local n3 = #tbl32 + 1
						tbl31[n2] = tbl30[v12]
						tbl32[n3] = v12
						tbl28[v12] = true
					end
				end

				if #tbl32 == 0 or not fn61() then
					return 0, 0, 0
				end

				if not pcall(function()
					petSatchel.SellSelection:FireServer({ Assets = {}, Eggs = tbl32 })
				end) then
					return 0, 0, #tbl31
				end
				local n2 = os.clock() + 2.5
				local eggInventory

				while true do
					local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
						return tbl20.Get()
					end)

					ok3 = ok3 and type(result3) == "table" and type(result3.EggInventory) == "table"
					eggInventory = nil

					if ok3 then
						eggInventory = result3.EggInventory
						local flag = true

						for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl32) do
							if eggInventory[v12] ~= nil then
								flag = false
								break
							end
						end

						if not flag then
							if not (n2 <= os.clock()) then
								task.wait(0.1)
								continue
							end
						end
					elseif not (n2 <= os.clock()) then
						task.wait(0.1)
						continue
					end

					break
				end

				local eggInventory2

				if eggInventory then
					task.wait(0.25)

					local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
						return tbl20.Get()
					end)

					eggInventory2 = ok3 and type(result3) == "table" and type(result3.EggInventory) == "table" and result3.EggInventory or nil
				else
					eggInventory2 = eggInventory
				end

				if not eggInventory2 then
					tbl6.forceDisarmEggSeller("Seller stopped · confirmation unavailable", "Egg selling stopped because the batch result could not be verified.", true)
					return 0, 0, #tbl31, "confirmation-unavailable"
				end
				local n3 = 0
				local n4 = 0

				for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl31) do
					if eggInventory2[tostring(v12.uid)] == nil then
						n3 += 1
						n4 += v12.price or 0
					end
				end

				for k in pairs(tbl29) do
					if not tbl28[k] and eggInventory2[k] == nil then
						tbl6.forceDisarmEggSeller("Seller stopped · unexpected inventory change", "Egg selling stopped because an egg outside the filtered batch disappeared.", true)
						return n3, n4, #tbl31 - n3, "unexpected-removal"
					end
				end

				return n3, n4, #tbl31 - n3
			end

			if #arg <= 1 then
				return fn60(arg, arg2, arg3)
			end
			local tbl25 = {}
			local n2 = 1
			local n3 = 0
			local n4 = 0
			local n5 = 0
			local n6 = 0
			local v12

			while true do
				if not (n2 <= #arg) then
					return n4, n5, n6
				else
					local n7 = arg2 and math.max(0, arg2 - n3) or 1
					if n7 <= 0 then
						return n4, n5, n6
					end
					local tbl26 = {}

					while n2 <= #arg and #tbl26 < math.min(1, n7) do
						local v13 = arg[n2]
						n2 += 1
						local str = tostring(v13.uid or "")

						if str ~= "" and not tbl25[str] then
							tbl25[str] = true
							tbl26[#tbl26 + 1] = v13
						end
					end

					if #tbl26 > 0 then
						local v13, v14, v15
						v13, v14, v15, v12 = fn60(tbl26, n7, arg3)
						n4 += v13
						n5 += v14
						n6 += v15
						n3 += v13 + v15
						if v12 then
							break
						end

						if v15 > 0 then
							return n4, n5, n6
						end
					end

					if n2 <= #arg then
						task.wait(0.35)
					end
				end
			end

			return n4, n5, n6, v12
		end

	tbl6.mergeBossSnapshot = function(arg, arg2)
		local v12 = table.clone(arg2)

		if arg and arg2.Open == true and arg.Open == true and arg2.OpensAt ~= nil and arg2.ClosesAt ~= nil and arg2.OpensAt == arg.OpensAt and arg2.ClosesAt == arg.ClosesAt then

				v12.BossHealth = arg.BossHealth
			end

			if v12.BossMaxHealth == nil then
				v12.BossMaxHealth = arg.BossMaxHealth
			end
		end

		return v12
	end

	tbl6.CreateRiftBossShopController = function(arg)
		local function fn44()
			if arg.exitIntent then
				arg.exitIntent(false)
			end

			arg.wantBody(false)
			arg.releaseBody()
		end

		return {
			bossStatus = "Off",
			shopStatus = "Off",
			nextSwing = 0,
			nextEntry = 0,
			nextPurchase = 0,
			swings = 0,
			purchases = 0,
			entry = arg.loadRequest("entry"),
			purchase = arg.loadRequest("purchase"),
			cursor = nil,
			nextExit = 0,
			exiting = false,
			exitDeadline = 0,
			shopStaying = false,
			shopIdleAt = 0,
			ObserveBoss = function(arg2, arg3, arg4)
				if not arg3 then
					return arg2.bossDefeated == true
				end
				local bossCycle = tostring(arg3.OpensAt) .. ":" .. tostring(arg3.ClosesAt)

				if arg2.bossCycle ~= bossCycle then
					arg2.bossCycle = bossCycle
					arg2.bossDefeated = false
					arg2.nextExit = 0
					arg2.exiting = false
					arg2.exitDeadline = 0
					arg2.shopStaying = false
					arg2.shopIdleAt = 0
				end

				local num = tonumber(arg3.BossHealth)
				local num2 = tonumber(arg3.BossMaxHealth)
				num = num and num <= 0 and num2 and num2 > 0
				local flag

				if num then
					flag = arg4 >= (tonumber(arg3.BossSpawnsAt) or 0)
				else
					flag = num
				end

				if flag then
					arg2.bossDefeated = true
				end

				return arg2.bossDefeated == true
			end,
			BossReady = function(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
				if not arg3 or arg3.Open ~= true then
					return false
				end
				local num = tonumber(arg3.BossSpawnsAt)
				local num2 = tonumber(arg3.BossHealth)
				if arg3.BossSpawnsAt ~= nil and (num == nil or num ~= num or num <= 0 or num >= math.huge or arg4 < num) then
					return false
				end

				if arg3.BossHealth ~= nil then
					return num2 ~= nil and num2 == num2 and num2 > 0 and num2 < math.huge
				end
				return arg5 == true
			end,
			StopBoss = function(arg2)
				fn44()
				arg2.exiting = false
				arg2.shopStaying = false
				arg2.bossStatus = arg2.entry and arg2.entry.inFlight and "Entry request finishing" or "Off"
			end,
			ResetCharacter = function(arg2, character)
				fn44()
				arg2.character = character
				arg2.nextSwing = 0
				arg2.nextEntry = 0
				arg2.stealIdleSince = nil
				arg2.exiting = false
				arg2.shopStaying = false

				if arg2.entry and not arg2.entry.inFlight then
					arg2.entry = nil
					arg.saveRequest("entry", nil)
				end
			end,
			LeaveArena = function(arg2, arg3)
				arg2.stealIdleSince = nil
				arg2.shopStaying = false
				arg2.exiting = arg3.inArena == true and arg3.alive == true

				if arg.exitIntent then
					arg.exitIntent(arg2.exiting)
				end

				if not arg2.exiting then
					fn44()
					return
				end
				arg.wantBody(true)
				if not arg.acquireBody() then
					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting to use the arena exit"
					return
				end

				if arg3.ragdolled then
					arg.stopMovement()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Recovering before arena exit"
					return
				end

				local v12 = arg.exitPortal()

				if not v12 then
					arg.stopMovement()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for arena leave Hitbox"
					return
				end

				arg.moveTo(v12.position, arg3.character)
				arg2.bossStatus = "Leaving through the boss arena portal"
			end,
			StepBoss = function(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
				local v12 = arg.now()

				if arg2.character ~= arg5.character then
					arg2:ResetCharacter(arg5.character)
				end

				local bossEnabled = arg2.bossEnabled
				arg2.bossEnabled = arg3.AutoRiftBoss == true
				if arg5.inArena and (not arg3.AutoRiftBoss and (bossEnabled or arg2.exiting or arg5.exitRequested) or arg5.exitRequested) then
					arg2:LeaveArena(arg5)
					return
				end

				if not arg5.inArena and arg2.exiting then
					arg2.exiting = false

					if arg.exitIntent then
						arg.exitIntent(false)
					end

					fn44()
				end

				if not arg3.AutoRiftBoss then
					arg2:StopBoss()
					return
				end

				if not arg5.alive then
					arg2.nextSwing = 0
					arg2.nextEntry = 0
					fn44()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for respawn"
					return
				end

				if arg5.stealPending then
					arg2.stealIdleSince = nil

					if arg5.inArena then
						arg2:LeaveArena(arg5)
					else
						fn44()
						arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for stealing to finish"
					end

					return
				end

				if arg2:ObserveBoss(arg4, arg5.serverNow) then
					if not arg5.inArena then
						arg2.shopStaying = false
						fn44()
						arg2.bossStatus = "Boss defeated · waiting for next rift"
						return
					end

					if arg2.shopWork == true or arg2.purchase and arg2.purchase.inFlight then
						arg2.shopStaying = true
						arg2.exiting = false

						if arg.exitIntent then
							arg.exitIntent(true)
						end

						arg.wantBody(true)
						arg.acquireBody()
						arg.stopMovement()
						arg2.bossStatus = "Boss defeated · finishing selected shop purchases"
						return
					end

					arg2:LeaveArena(arg5)
					return
				end

				if arg5.inArena and arg4 and arg4.Open ~= true then
					arg2:LeaveArena(arg5)
					return
				end

				if arg2.entry then
					local entry = arg2.entry

					if entry.inFlight then
						if not arg3.AutoRiftBoss or arg5.protected then
							fn44()
						end

						arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for arena entry"

						if arg3.AutoRiftBoss and not arg5.protected then
							arg.wantBody(true)
							arg.acquireBody()
						end

						return
					end

					if not (entry.character ~= arg5.character or arg5.inArena or v12 - entry.finishedAt > 3 or entry.accepted == false) then
						arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for arena replication"
						return
					end
					arg2.entry = nil
					arg.saveRequest("entry", nil)
					arg2.nextEntry = v12 + 3

					if entry.accepted ~= true and not arg5.inArena then
						arg2.bossStatus = "Arena entry: " .. tostring(entry.message or entry.accepted)
					end
				end

				if arg5.protected then
					fn44()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for the current egg transaction"
					return
				end

				if not arg5.eligible then
					fn44()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Rift Boss is locked"
					return
				end

				if not arg4 then
					fn44()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Checking Rift Boss"
					return
				end

				if not arg5.inArena and arg4.Open ~= true then
					fn44()
					local n2 = math.max(0, math.ceil((tonumber(arg4.OpensAt) or arg5.serverNow) - arg5.serverNow))

				end

				if not arg5.inArena and not arg2:BossReady(arg4, arg5.serverNow, arg5.bossLive) then

					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for boss spawn"
					return

						return

				arg.wantBody(true)
				if arg5.busy or not arg.acquireBody() then
					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for other automation"
					return
				end

					if v12 < arg2.nextEntry then
						return
					end
					local entry = { inFlight = true, started = v12, character = arg5.character }

						local v13 = entry
						local v14 = entry
						local v15 = entry
						local ok3, accepted, message = pcall(arg.enterArena, entry.character)
						v13.ok = ok3
						v14.accepted = accepted
						v15.message = message
						local v16 = entry
						entry.finishedAt = arg.now()
						v16.inFlight = false
					end)

					return
				end

				if arg4.Open ~= true then
					fn44()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for the next boss"
					return
				end

				if arg5.ragdolled then
					arg.stopMovement()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Recovering from a hit"
					return
				end

				if not arg5.bat then
					arg.stopMovement()
					arg2.bossStatus = "A bat is needed to attack"
					return
				end

				if not arg5.target then
					arg.stopMovement()
					arg2.bossStatus = "Waiting for a vulnerable boss target"
					return
				end

				if not arg.equipBat(arg5.bat, arg5.character) then
					arg2.bossStatus = "Equipping bat"
					return
				end

				if arg5.attackRange < arg5.target.distance then
					arg.moveTo(arg5.target.position, arg5.character)
					arg2.bossStatus = "Approaching " .. arg5.target.name
					return
				end

				arg.stopMovement()
				if not arg5.batReady or v12 < arg2.nextSwing then
					arg2.bossStatus = "Attacking " .. arg5.target.name
					return
				end

				arg2.nextSwing = v12 + (v13 and 0.15 or 0.35)

				if v13 then
					arg2.swings = arg2.swings + 1
				end

				arg2.bossStatus = v13 and "Attacking " .. arg5.target.name or "Waiting for the bat"
			end,
			ChooseProduct = function(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
				if type(arg5) ~= "number" or arg5 ~= arg5 or arg5 < 0 then
					return nil
				end
				local n2 = 1

				for i, v12 in ipairs(arg4) do
					if v12.id == arg2.cursor then
						n2 = i % #arg4 + 1
						break
					end
				end

				for i = 0, #arg4 - 1 do
					local v12 = arg4[(n2 + i - 1) % #arg4 + 1]
					if arg3.RiftShopItems[v12.id] == true and type(v12.price) == "number" and v12.price == v12.price and v12.price > 0 and v12.price < math.huge and arg5 >= v12.price then
						return v12
					end
				end

				return nil
			end,
			StepShop = function(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6)
				local v12 = arg.now()
				local purchase = arg2.purchase
				arg2.shopWork = arg3.AutoBuyRiftShop == true and not (purchase ~= nil and not purchase.inFlight and (not purchase.ok or purchase.accepted ~= true and purchase.accepted ~= false)) and (purchase ~= nil or arg6 == true and type(arg3.RiftShopItems) == "table" and next(arg3.RiftShopItems) ~= nil and arg2:ChooseProduct(arg3, arg4, arg5) ~= nil)

				if arg2.purchase then
					local purchase2 = arg2.purchase
					if purchase2.inFlight then
						arg2.shopStatus = "Buying " .. purchase2.name
						return
					end

					if not purchase2.ok or purchase2.accepted ~= true and purchase2.accepted ~= false then
						arg2.shopStatus = "Purchase response unavailable · auto-buy paused"
						return
					end

					if purchase2.ok and purchase2.accepted == true then
						if type(arg5) ~= "number" or arg5 > purchase2.beforeTokens - purchase2.price then
							arg2.shopStatus = "Purchased " .. purchase2.name .. " · updating tokens"
							return
						end
						arg2.purchases = arg2.purchases + 1
						arg2.shopStatus = "Purchased " .. purchase2.name
					else
						arg2.shopStatus = "Shop: " .. tostring(purchase2.message or purchase2.accepted or "response unavailable")
					end

					arg2.cursor = purchase2.id
					arg2.purchase = nil
					arg.saveRequest("purchase", nil)
					arg2.nextPurchase = v12 + (purchase2.ok and purchase2.accepted == true and 2 or 5)
					return
				end

				if not arg3.AutoBuyRiftShop then
					arg2.shopStatus = "Off"
					return
				end

				if not next(arg3.RiftShopItems) then
					arg2.shopStatus = "Choose shop items"
					return
				end

				if not arg6 then
					arg2.shopStatus = "Waiting for shop data"
					return
				end

				if v12 < arg2.nextPurchase then
					return
				end
				local v13 = arg2:ChooseProduct(arg3, arg4, arg5)
				if not v13 then
					arg2.shopStatus = "Waiting for enough Boss Tokens"
					return
				end
				local v14, v15 = arg.validatePurchase(v13.id)
				if not arg3.AutoBuyRiftShop or arg3.RiftShopItems[v13.id] ~= true or not v14 or v14.id ~= v13.id or type(v14.price) ~= "number" or v14.price ~= v14.price or v14.price <= 0 or v14.price >= math.huge or type(v15) ~= "number" or v15 ~= v15 or v15 < v14.price then
					return
				end

				local purchase2 = {
					id = v14.id,
					name = v14.name,
					price = v14.price,
					beforeTokens = v15,
					inFlight = true,
					started = v12,
				}

				arg2.purchase = purchase2
				arg.saveRequest("purchase", purchase2)
				arg2.shopStatus = "Buying " .. purchase2.name

				arg.spawn(function()
					local v16 = purchase2
					local v17 = purchase2
					local v18 = purchase2
					local ok3, accepted, message = pcall(arg.buyProduct, purchase2.id)
					v16.ok = ok3
					v17.accepted = accepted
					v18.message = message
					local v19 = purchase2
					purchase2.finishedAt = arg.now()
					v19.inFlight = false
				end)
			end,
			Destroy = function(arg2)
				arg2:StopBoss()
			end,
		}
	end

	tbl6.createFuseController = function(arg)
		local function fn44(arg2)
			return type(arg2) == "number" and arg2 == arg2 and arg2 >= 0 and arg2 < math.huge
		end

		local tbl21

		tbl21 = {
			owned = {},
			pending = nil,
			status = "Off",
			completed = 0,
			eligible = function(arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
				local settings_2 = arg.settings
				if type(arg3) ~= "table" or settings_2.FuseCategories[arg3.Category] ~= true then
					return false
				end

				if not fn44(settings_2.FuseMinimumValue) or not fn44(settings_2.FuseKGThreshold) or settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Any" and settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Above" and settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Below" then
					return false
				end

				if arg3.IsFavorite == true or arg3.InFuse == true ~= arg5 then
					return false
				end
				local v12 = pairs
				local equippedAssets = arg4.EquippedAssets or {}

				for _, equippedAsset in v12(equippedAssets) do
					if tostring(equippedAsset) == tostring(arg2) then
						return false
					end
				end

				if arg.protected(arg2, arg4) then
					return false
				end
				local ok3, result3 = pcall(arg.mayEnter, arg2, arg3, nil, arg5)
				if not ok3 or result3 ~= true then
					return false
				end
				local ok4, result4 = pcall(arg.decode, arg3)
				if not ok4 or type(result4) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				if settings_2.FuseKGMode ~= "Any" and settings_2.FuseKGThreshold > 0 then
					local v13 = arg.weight(result4)
					if not fn44(v13) or arg.kgMatches(v13, settings_2.FuseKGMode, settings_2.FuseKGThreshold, true) then
						return false
					end
				end

				if settings_2.FuseMinimumValue > 0 then
					local v13, v14 = arg.value(result4)
					if not v14 or not fn44(v13) or v13 >= settings_2.FuseMinimumValue then
						return false
					end
				end

				return true, result4
			end,
			plan = function(arg2)
				if type(arg2) ~= "table" or type(arg2.Inventory) ~= "table" or type(arg2.FusionSlots) ~= "table" then
					return nil, "Waiting for fuse data"
				end
				local tbl22 = {}
				local tbl23 = {}
				local flag = nil

				for i = 1, 3 do
					local v12 = arg2.FusionSlots[i]

					if v12 then
						if tbl23[v12] or not tbl21.owned[v12] then
							return nil, "Machine has manually loaded pets"
						end
						tbl23[v12] = true
						local v13 = arg2.Inventory[v12]
						if not tbl21.eligible(v12, v13, arg2, true) then
							return nil, "Returning a protected pet", v12
						end
						flag = flag and v13.Category ~= flag
						if flag then
							return nil, "Returning mismatched pet", v12
						end
						flag = v13.Category
						tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = v12
					end
				end

				local tbl24 = {}

				if flag then
					tbl24[flag] = table.clone(tbl22)
				end

				for k, v12 in pairs(arg2.Inventory) do
					if not tbl23[k] and (not flag or v12.Category == flag) and tbl21.eligible(k, v12, arg2, false) then
						tbl24[v12.Category] = tbl24[v12.Category] or {}
						table.insert(tbl24[v12.Category], k)
					end
				end

				local tbl25 = {}

				for k, v12 in pairs(tbl24) do
					if #v12 >= 3 then
						tbl25[#tbl25 + 1] = k
					end
				end

				table.sort(tbl25)
				if #tbl25 == 0 then
					return nil, "Waiting for 3 eligible pets of one category"
				end
				local tbl26 = {}

				for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl24[tbl25[1]]) do
					if not tbl23[v12] then
						tbl26[#tbl26 + 1] = v12
					end
				end

				table.sort(tbl26, function(arg3, arg4)
					return tostring(arg3) < tostring(arg4)
				end)

				local v12 = table.clone(tbl22)

				for _, v13 in ipairs(tbl26) do
					if #v12 ~= 3 then
						v12[#v12 + 1] = v13
						continue
					end
					break
				end

				return { uids = v12, loaded = #tbl22, category = tbl25[1] }, "Ready"
			end,
			tick = function()
				if not arg.alive() then
					return
				end

				if not arg.idle() then
					tbl21.status = "Waiting for idle time"
					return
				end

				if not arg.ready() then
					tbl21.status = "Waiting for filter edits to finish"
					return
				end
				local v12 = arg.save()
				if type(v12) ~= "table" or type(v12.FusionSlots) ~= "table" then
					tbl21.status = "Waiting for fuse data"
					return
				end

				if tbl21.pending then
					local pending = tbl21.pending
					local flag = pending.action == "BeginFuse" and pending.uids ~= nil

					if flag then
						for _, uid in ipairs(pending.uids) do
							if v12.Inventory[uid] then
								flag = false
								break
							end
						end
					end

					local flag2 = pending.action == "LoadPet" and v12.Inventory[pending.uid] and v12.Inventory[pending.uid].InFuse == true
					local flag3

					if flag2 then
						flag3 = flag2
					else
						local flag4 = pending.action == "EjectPet"

						if flag4 then
							flag3 = not v12.Inventory[pending.uid] or not v12.Inventory[pending.uid].InFuse
						else
							flag3 = flag4
						end
					end

					local flag4 = not (flag3 or pending.action == "BeginFuse" and (v12.FusionLocked == true or type(v12.FusionEggReward) == "table" or flag) or pending.action == "FinishReveal" and v12.FusionEggReward == false)
					local flag5

					if flag4 then
						local at = pending.at
						flag5 = arg.now() - at < 8
					else
						flag5 = flag4
					end

					if flag5 then
						tbl21.status = "Waiting for machine confirmation"
						return
					end

					if flag4 then
						arg.disable()
						tbl21.status = "Machine confirmation timed out; Auto Fuse stopped"
						tbl21.pending = nil
						return
					end

					tbl21.pending = nil
				end

				if v12.FusionEggReward ~= false and v12.FusionEggReward ~= nil then
					if not arg.settings.AutoFuse then
						tbl21.status = "Reward waiting in machine"
						return
					end

					if type(v12.FusionEndsAt) == "number" and v12.FusionEndsAt > arg.serverNow() then
						tbl21.status = "Fusing"
						return
					end
					tbl21.status = "Claiming fused egg"
					tbl21.pending = { action = "FinishReveal", at = arg.now() }
					local FinishReveal, v13 = arg.request("FinishReveal")

					if FinishReveal == false then
						tbl21.pending = nil
						tbl21.status = tostring(v13 or "Reward not ready")
					end

					return
				end

				if v12.FusionLocked == true then
					tbl21.status = "Fusing"
					return
				end
				local tbl22 = {}

				for _, fusionSlot in pairs(v12.FusionSlots) do
					if fusionSlot then
						tbl22[fusionSlot] = true
					end
				end

				for k in pairs(tbl21.owned) do
					if not tbl22[k] then
						tbl21.owned[k] = nil
					end
				end

				local v13, v14, v15 = tbl21.plan(v12)
				local v16

				if not arg.settings.AutoFuse then
					local v17, v18, v19 = pairs(tbl21.owned)
					local v20 = table.pack(a_1())
					local v21

					if v20[1] then
						v21 = v20[2]
					else
						v21 = v15
					end

					if not v21 then
						tbl21.status = "Off"
						return
					end
					v16 = v21
				else
					v16 = v15
				end

				if v16 then
					tbl21.status = "Returning protected/unused pet"
					tbl21.pending = { action = "EjectPet", uid = v16, at = arg.now() }
					local EjectPet, v17 = arg.request("EjectPet", v16)

					if EjectPet == false then
						tbl21.pending = nil
						tbl21.status = tostring(v17 or "Cannot return pet")
					end

					return
				end

				if not v13 then
					tbl21.status = v14
					return
				end
				local v17, v18, v19 = arg.capacity()
				if v17 or not v19 then
					tbl21.status = "Waiting for egg inventory space"
					return
				end
				local v20 = arg.price(v12, v13.uids)
				if not fn44(v20) or not fn44(v12.Money) or v12.Money < v20 then
					tbl21.status = "Waiting for fuse cost"
					return
				end

				if not arg.alive() or not arg.settings.AutoFuse or not arg.idle() or not arg.ready() then
					return
				end

				if v13.loaded < 3 then
					local v21 = v13.uids[v13.loaded + 1]
					local v22 = arg.save()
					local v23 = tbl21.plan(v22)
					if not v23 or v23.uids[v23.loaded + 1] ~= v21 or v23.loaded ~= v13.loaded then
						return
					end
					tbl21.owned[v21] = true
					tbl21.pending = { action = "LoadPet", uid = v21, at = arg.now() }
					tbl21.status = "Loading " .. v13.category .. " (" .. tostring(v13.loaded + 1) .. "/3)"
					local LoadPet, v24 = arg.request("LoadPet", v21)

					if LoadPet == false then
						tbl21.pending = nil
						tbl21.owned[v21] = nil
						tbl21.status = tostring(v24 or "Pet rejected")
					end
				else
					local v21 = arg.save()
					local v22 = tbl21.plan(v21)
					if not v22 or v22.loaded ~= 3 or v21.FusionLocked ~= false or v21.FusionEggReward ~= false then
						return
					end

					for i, uid in ipairs(v13.uids) do
						if v22.uids[i] ~= uid then
							return
						end
					end

					if not arg.settings.AutoFuse or not arg.idle() or not arg.ready() then
						return
					end
					tbl21.status = "Fusing " .. v13.category
					tbl21.pending = { action = "BeginFuse", at = arg.now(), uids = table.clone(v13.uids) }
					local BeginFuse, v23 = arg.request("BeginFuse")

					if BeginFuse == false then
						tbl21.pending = nil
						tbl21.status = tostring(v23 or "Fuse rejected")
					elseif BeginFuse == true then
						tbl21.completed = tbl21.completed + 1
					end
				end
			end,
		}

		return tbl21
	end

	local function fn44()
		local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
			local v12 = v2.__FuseTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Auto Fuse")
			v2.__FuseBox = v12
			local FuseStatus = nil

			tbl3.Merge(v12, function()
				FuseStatus = v12:AddLabel("FuseStatus", { Text = "Off", DoesWrap = true })
			end)

			local function fn45()
				fn13(true)
				tbl6.markValueFilterChanged()
			end

			fn5(v12, "FuseCategories", "Categories", tbl11.Items, {
				configKey = "FuseCategories",
				multi = true,
				store = tbl4.FuseCategories,
				text = "Categories",
				displayMap = tbl11.Display,
				tooltip = "Fuse only these categories. Empty = nothing. Each fuse consumes 3 pets of the same category.",
				onChange = fn45,
			})

			tbl6.addKGFilterControls(v12, "Fuse", "FuseKGMode", "FuseKGThreshold", fn45, true)
			tbl6.addValueFilterInput(v12, "FuseMinimumValue", "FuseMinimumValue", "Prevent Minimum Value", fn45, "Keep pets at this income per second and above. K, M, B, T work; 0 disables.")

			local AutoFuseToggle = v12:AddToggle("AutoFuseToggle", {
				Text = "Auto Fuse",
				Default = tbl4.AutoFuse,
				Tooltip = "Fuse selected pets only while other automation is idle. Each fuse consumes 3 pets and charges the game's fuse price.",
			})

			AutoFuseToggle:OnChanged(function(arg)
				tbl4.AutoFuse = arg == true
				fn13(true)
			end)

			getgenv().__SCARLET_ConfigControllers.AutoFuse = {
				GetValue = function()
					return tbl4.AutoFuse
				end,
				SetValue = function(arg, arg2)
					AutoFuseToggle:SetValue(arg2 == true)
				end,

	tbl6.createServerBrowser = function(arg)
		local function fn47(arg2)
			return type(arg2) == "number" and arg2 == arg2 and arg2 >= 0 and arg2 < math.huge
		end

		return {
			rows = {},
			selected = nil,
			busy = false,
			revision = 0,
			status = "Enable Find Server or press Refresh",
			lastSuccess = nil,
			nextRefresh = 0,
			Cancel = function(arg2)
				arg2.revision = arg2.revision + 1
				arg2.busy = false
				arg2.status = "Find Server off"
				arg.render(arg2)
			end,
			Select = function(arg2, selected)
				for _, row in ipairs(arg2.rows) do
					if row.id == selected then
						arg2.selected = selected
						arg.render(arg2)
						return true
					end
				end

				return false
			end,
			Refresh = function(arg2)
				local busy = not arg.alive() or arg2.busy

				if not busy then
					local nextRefresh = arg2.nextRefresh
					busy = arg.now() < nextRefresh
				end

				if busy then
					return false
				end
				arg2.revision = arg2.revision + 1
				local revision = arg2.revision
				arg2.busy = true
				arg2.nextRefresh = arg.now() + 10
				arg2.status = "Finding least-populated servers..."
				arg.render(arg2)

				local function fn48()
					return arg.alive() and arg2.revision == revision
				end

				arg.delay(25, function()
					if fn48() and arg2.busy then
						arg2.revision = arg2.revision + 1
						arg2.busy = false
						arg2.lastSuccess = nil
						arg2.nextRefresh = arg.now() + 60
						arg2.status = "Request timed out. Try Refresh later."
						arg.render(arg2)
					end
				end)

				local ok3, rows = pcall(function()
					local tbl21 = {}
					local tbl22 = {}
					local tbl23 = {}
					local nextPageCursor = nil

					for i = 1, 3 do
						local v12 = arg.fetch(nextPageCursor)
						if not fn48() then
							return nil
						end
						assert(type(v12) == "table" and type(v12.data) == "table", "Invalid server response")

						for _, v13 in ipairs(v12.data) do
							if type(v13) == "table" and type(v13.id) == "string" and v13.id ~= "" and v13.id ~= arg.jobId and not tbl22[v13.id] and fn47(v13.playing) and fn47(v13.maxPlayers) and v13.playing % 1 == 0 and v13.maxPlayers % 1 == 0 and v13.playing < v13.maxPlayers then
								tbl22[v13.id] = true

								tbl21[#tbl21 + 1] = {
									id = v13.id,
									playing = v13.playing,
									maxPlayers = v13.maxPlayers,
									ping = fn47(v13.ping) and v13.ping or nil,
									fps = fn47(v13.fps) and v13.fps or nil,
								}
							end
						end

						nextPageCursor = v12.nextPageCursor
						if #tbl21 >= 20 or type(nextPageCursor) ~= "string" or nextPageCursor == "" or tbl23[nextPageCursor] then
							break
						end
						tbl23[nextPageCursor] = true
					end

					table.sort(tbl21, function(arg3, arg4)
						if arg3.playing ~= arg4.playing then
							return arg3.playing < arg4.playing
						end

						if arg3.ping ~= arg4.ping then
							return (arg3.ping or math.huge) < (arg4.ping or math.huge)
						end
						return arg3.id < arg4.id
					end)

					while #tbl21 > 20 do
						table.remove(tbl21)
					end

					return tbl21
				end)

				if not fn48() then
					return false
				end
				arg2.busy = false
				arg2.nextRefresh = arg.now() + (ok3 and 10 or 60)

				if not ok3 then
					arg2.lastSuccess = nil
					arg2.status = "Refresh failed: " .. tostring(rows):gsub("^.-:%d+: ", ""):sub(1, 150)
					arg.render(arg2)
					return false
				end

				local v12 = arg.now()
				arg2.rows = rows
				arg2.lastSuccess = v12
				local flag = false

				for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
					if row.id == arg2.selected then
						flag = true
						break
					end
				end

				if not flag then
					arg2.selected = rows[1] and rows[1].id or nil
				end

				arg2.status = #rows > 0 and tostring(#rows) .. " servers found · Fewest players first" or "No available public servers. Try Refresh later."
				arg.render(arg2)
				return true
			end,
			Hop = function(arg2)
				if arg2.busy then
					return false, "Wait for the server refresh"
				end
				local flag = not arg2.lastSuccess

				if not flag then
					local lastSuccess = arg2.lastSuccess
					flag = arg.now() - lastSuccess > 90
				end

				if flag then
					return false, "Refresh the server list first"
				end

				for _, row in ipairs(arg2.rows) do
					if row.id == arg2.selected and row.id ~= arg.jobId and row.playing < row.maxPlayers then
						return arg.teleport(row.id)
					end
				end

				return false, "No available server selected"
			end,
		}
	end

				end

					return true

				if arg.WasEnabled ~= true or not arg.Enable then
					scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Rejoin = true
					return true
				end
				return pcall(arg.Enable, object) and (fn65(object, "Enabled") == true or fn65(object, "Connected") == false)
			end

				local tbl23 = {}

				tbl23[3] = v17

				local str = "Unsupported: idle callback API unavailable"

			local function fn73(arg, arg2)
				if not fn67(arg2) then
					return false, "Idle callback update superseded"

				if fn65(arg, "Connected") == false then
					return true, nil, "gone"
				end

				if enabled == false then

				end

				local str = "Disable"

				if not disable then
					str = "Disconnect"
					disable = fn66(arg, "Disconnect")
				end

				if not disable then
					return false, "Unsupported: callback cannot be disabled"
				end
				local tbl23 = scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Records[arg]

				if not tbl23 then
					if fn68() >= 512 then
						return false, "Idle callback tracking limit reached"
					end
					tbl23 = { Object = arg, Owner = owner, WasEnabled = enabled, Enable = fn66(arg, "Enable"), Kind = str }
					scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Records[arg] = tbl23
				end

				local connected = fn65(arg, "Connected")
				local flag4 = str == "Disable" and enabled2 == true or str == "Disconnect" and connected == true

				if str == "Disconnect" and not flag4 then
					if not tbl23.Counted then
						scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Disconnected = scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Disconnected + 1
						tbl23.Counted = true
					end

					scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Rejoin = true
				elseif str == "Disable" and not flag4 and (enabled == nil or not tbl23.Enable) then

				end

				if not fn67(arg2) then
					if fn69(tbl23) then
						scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Records[arg] = nil
					end

					return false, "Idle callback update superseded"
				end

				if not ok4 then
					return false, "Idle callback disable failed: " .. tostring(result4)
				end

				if flag4 then
					return false, "Idle callback disable had no effect"
				end
				return true, nil, (enabled2 == false or fn65(arg, "Connected") == false) and "verified" or "unknown"
			end

			local function fn74(arg)
				if not fn67(arg) then

					end
				end

									elseif v20 and v22 == "unknown" then
										unknown += 1
									end

									if not v20 then
										error_ = error_ or v21
									end
								end

								continue
							end
						end

						break
					end
				end

				if scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Busy == busy then
					scarletAFKCallbackRecords.Busy = nil
				end

				if not fn67(arg) then
					fn71()
					return false, "Idle callback update superseded"
				end

				local v20 = owner

				v19.Verified = verified

				local v22 = owner

				return error_ == nil, error_
			end
